* 6–8 years of experience as a **Pre‑Sales Solutions Engineer** delivering enterprise networking and wireless solutions
* Understanding in L2/L3 switching and routing on Aruba CX and Juniper EX/QFX platforms
* Strong skills in **VLAN design, segmentation, inter‑VLAN routing** , and traffic optimization

* Solid background in WAN/SD‑WAN, Juniper SRX routing, MPLS to internet migration, and VPNs
* Knowledge of **network security integration** , NAC with ClearPass, and secure BYOD access
* Proven ability to deliver **HLDs, LLDs, BoQs, PoCs** , and support winning technical proposals

**Solution Architecting**

* Engage with sales, channel partners, and enterprise customers to gather business and technical requirements

**Customer Engagement \& Consultative Selling**

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, delivering solution presentations, demos, and architecture walkthroughs
* Support wired and wireless PoCs and translate technical designs into clear business value propositions

**RFP / Proposal \& Deal Support**

* Lead technical responses for RFPs/RFIs/RFQs, including compliance matrices, solution narratives, and scope documents
* Support deal qualification, pricing discussions, OEM registrations, and solution validation with distributors and OEM teams

**Collaboration \& Delivery Readiness**

* Coordinate with professional services and deployment teams to ensure smooth handover and implementation readiness
* Maintain detailed design documentation and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and delivery teams

**Mandatory Skills (JD Aligned)**

* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ICMP) with an enterprise design and troubleshooting mindset

**Certifications \& Education**

* OEM and vendor‑neutral certifications such as Aruba and Juniper (as applicable)
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BE/B.Tech) or equivalent qualification

c22b7f28.description:

Job Description:


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex Palo Alto Networks technical issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve advanced issues related to Palo Alto NGFW (PA\-Series, VM\-Series, CN\-Series) and Panorama.
* Support and manage Prisma Access, Prisma SD\-WAN, and SASE deployments.

* Deep knowledge of Security Policies, NAT, VPN (IPSec \& GlobalProtect), URL Filtering, Threat Prevention, and WildFire.

* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and SSL/TLS.
* Experience with Prisma Access, SASE, and cloud security technologies.
* Knowledge of Cortex XDR, Cortex XSOAR, and Cortex XSIAM is preferred.

----------------------------

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)
* Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access Certification

* CCNP Security
* CISSP
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Security Certifications

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* 8\-12 years of experience in Network Security, TAC, or Cybersecurity Support environments.
* Minimum 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting Palo Alto Networks technologies.
* Experience handling enterprise and global customer environments.
* Strong knowledge of security operations and incident management processes.
* Experience working in a 24x7 TAC or Managed Security Services environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and customer\-facing skills.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and drive technical excellence within the team.

fdca53c0.description:
**Your Job**
Molex is seeking a Senior Kinaxis Solution Architect to help drive the evolution of our global supply chain planning capabilities. In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to supply chain and IT stakeholders, designing scalable solutions that improve planning effectiveness across demand, supply, capacity, and Sales \& Operations Planning processes. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our digital planning landscape while delivering capabilities that create value across a complex global manufacturing network


**Our Team**


You will join Molex's Digital Supply Chain Planning team, a global organization focused on advancing planning capabilities through technology, process excellence, and data\-driven decision making. Our team partners closely with business leaders, planners, and technology teams around the world to enable a more connected, agile, and resilient supply chain.


**What You Will Do**  

  



* Serve as the Kinaxis Solution Architect for supply chain planning capabilities, partnering with business and IT stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Lead discovery workshops and planning initiatives to identify opportunities that enhance end\-to\-end supply chain performance.
* Architect and enhance global Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP), demand planning, supply planning, capacity planning, and execution\-related capabilities within the Kinaxis platform.
* Design and optimize Kinaxis RapidResponse and Maestro solutions that improve decision\-making, visibility, and planning effectiveness.
* Guide integration strategies between Kinaxis and ERP platforms to ensure reliable and accurate planning data across the enterprise.
* Drive successful solution delivery through design, testing, deployment, hypercare support, and continuous improvement activities.
* Evaluate emerging Kinaxis capabilities and technology enhancements to help shape the future supply chain planning roadmap.

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**
  

* Experience supporting supply chain planning systems and advanced planning solutions, including demand planning, supply planning, Sales \& Operations Planning (S\&OP), and related end\-to\-end planning processes.
* Hands\-on expertise with Kinaxis RapidResponse and/or Maestro, including solution design, configuration, data modeling, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Working knowledge of SAP planning and MRP concepts, including experience integrating Kinaxis with ERP platforms.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical and functional solution specifications and supporting solution delivery through testing and deployment activities.
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or another related STEM field.

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

  



* Kinaxis certifications, including Solution Architect and/or Admin/Author Level 3\.
* Experience designing and supporting integrations involving planning master data, SAP tables, and closed\-loop planning processes.
* Expertise in performance tuning, constraint management, BOMs, routings, scenario analysis, and optimization of large\-scale planning solutions.
* Experience leading global implementations and influencing adoption of standardized planning processes and solution best practices.
* Experience supporting highly integrated planning environments within a global manufacturing organization.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**


At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.


Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

* Hands\-on experience assessing and reverse\-engineering legacy applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

22d84b87.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join a team where your expertise in cybersecurity architecture shapes the future of secure technology solutions. Grow your career by collaborating with top engineering, product, and business professionals.


As a Lead Cybersecurity Architect at JPMorgan Chase within the Cybersecurity and Technology Controls team, you will design and deliver high\-quality cybersecurity solutions for software applications and platform products. You will partner with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are secure by design, resilient, and aligned to regulatory and audit expectations. You will play a key role in supporting Chase UK and JPMorgan Personal Investing, contributing to a collaborative and innovative team culture. You will help drive impactful outcomes for the firm and its clients.

**Job responsibilities**

* Perform secure design reviews and threat modeling with application teams to ensure products are secure by design.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of product strategy, roadmap, and key investment programs.
* Identify and learn unfamiliar technology components, capabilities, and business concepts, applying critical thinking to uncover hidden issues.
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate cybersecurity architecture analysis and decisioning (e.g., risk identification and documentation), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Drives reuse\-first adoption of AI\-assisted security validation within SDLC/toolchain routines, improving control testing and remediation quality with traceability/auditability and resiliency expectations.
* Share best practices and serve as the point of escalation and subject matter expert for Cybersecurity and Technology Controls.
* Collaborate with product, technology, and business colleagues for audit, regulatory, risk, and project initiatives.
* Work with Third Party Oversight teams to manage technology risk for vendors, focusing on cloud computing and emerging technologies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Formal training or certification on security engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Advanced knowledge of cybersecurity architecture, applications, and technical processes with expertise in one or more technical disciplines
* Ability to design and implement effective cybersecurity and technology controls
* Strong knowledge of security best practices and DevSecOps methodologies
* Experience with cloud security posture management and vulnerability management
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support cybersecurity architecture workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to assess and validate AI\-assisted security recommendations before adoption, escalating uncertainty and ensuring outcomes align to security, resiliency, and auditability expectations.
* Understanding of network security, network design, segmentation, firewalls, and cloud networking patterns
* Experience implementing and reviewing authentication and authorization controls and best practices
* Hands\-on experience in software development with strong understanding of SDLC and secure SDLC practices
* Knowledge of modern application architectures including microservices, APIs, and event\-driven patterns

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Experience with identity federation, least privilege, RBAC/ABAC concepts
* Experience with cloud security technologies and emerging security trends
* Ability to influence and partner across product supply chains
* Experience working with Third Party Oversight teams and managing vendor technology risk


**ABOUT US**

1689b377.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
1689b377.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team:**  

InsurTech is Expedia Group’s team for **insurance and assurance products** . It identifies, incubates, and scales products that drive revenue and fit into the traveler journey, and it owns the end\-to\-end technology strategy and execution for those products.
  

In practice, the team builds reusable shop/book/serve capabilities for insurance and fintech offerings across Expedia brands, and focuses on things like supply integration, checkout, servicing, claims, content, experimentation, and ML/data platforms.
  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the definition, planning, and delivery of complex, multi\-team technical programs across the Insurtech organization, with a focus on Insurance and embedded flexibility products, ensuring clear problem framing, measurable outcomes, and alignment to Expedia Group’s strategic objectives.
* Drive innovative programs that improve the traveler experience while delivering significant impact to a P\&L business within Expedia Group, translating strategy into executable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable business and customer outcomes.
* Drive end\-to\-end program execution by establishing program structures, roadmaps, and success metrics; proactively identifying cross\-team dependencies; and resolving risks and issues to maintain predictable delivery across engineering, product, business, and partner stakeholders.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to shape technical solutions, including system design, API contracts, and data flows, and ensure design decisions support scalability, resilience, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with supplier partners and cross\-functional teams across global markets to deliver customer and commercial value at scale, align priorities, and accelerate execution across a distributed ecosystem.
* Create and operate effective governance and communication mechanisms, including steering forums, technical reviews, and decision logs, that provide transparency, enable timely trade\-offs, and keep executives, partner organizations, and stakeholders informed and engaged.
* Drive breakthrough and 0\-to\-1 product development outcomes by enabling experimentation, validating new opportunities, and helping teams turn emerging concepts into scalable products and platform capabilities.
* Champion and implement best practices in technical program management at scale, including standardized planning, execution, and operational excellence practices, while mentoring other TPMs and influencing how programs are run across the broader organization.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes by coordinating experimentation, rollout, and monitoring plans, and ensuring teams have the practices and controls needed to use AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows responsibly and effectively.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience leading complex technology initiatives.
* Extensive experience (typically 10\+ years) in technical program management, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of large, cross\-team, or multi\-service programs in a technology organization.
* Proven ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams on technical topics such as distributed system design, API design, data modeling, and integration patterns, and to translate technical details into clear, outcome\-focused plans.
* Demonstrated success driving programs from concept through launch and ongoing iteration, including definition of measurable objectives, risk and dependency management, and establishing mechanisms for tracking and reporting progress at scale.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including partnering with engineering and data teams to ensure such capabilities are integrated and operated safely and effectively within program scope.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Track record of leading multi\-quarter, multi\-team technical transformations, platform initiatives, or 0\-to\-1 product programs, operating at organization or domain scale and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes across product, engineering, and business teams.
* Experience delivering in highly regulated product environments, with the ability to incorporate compliance, risk, privacy, security, and operational control requirements into program planning, execution, and decision\-making.
* Strong experience with B2C program and product development, including delivering customer\-facing capabilities that improve user experience, drive adoption, and balance customer value with measurable business outcomes.
* Deep experience influencing technical direction through program work, including coordinating architectural reviews, driving alignment on system and API design decisions, and ensuring data models and integration approaches enable long\-term extensibility, reuse, and partner interoperability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with external partners, suppliers, and third\-party providers, aligning joint roadmaps, managing dependencies, and delivering shared outcomes across internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ability to design and improve program operating models and execution frameworks, including mechanisms that enhance reliability, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement for large\-scale, customer\-facing systems.
* Strong data\-driven decision\-making skills, including defining and instrumenting key technical and business metrics, using data to assess program health and trade\-offs, and adjusting plans based on empirical evidence, experimentation results, and evolving market or partner inputs.
* Safely integrates and operates AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, with experience steering AI/ML\-related programs such as personalization, automation, or decision\-support capabilities, including responsible use guardrails, evaluation methods, and collaboration with specialized AI/ML teams.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

6d7abe16.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Amazon Leo for Government
6d7abe16.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low\-latency, high\-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The mission of Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) is to enable Leo to provide high speed, low latency, and secure satellite broadband services to United States and allied government customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 We have an immediate opening for a Sr Solutions Architect to support the Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) team focusing on ANZ Government customers. This position will be part of the ALG team working with Business Development and customers to define Leo Government family of products within Leo’s broadband space network for high throughput, low latency broadband communications. This is a unique opportunity to innovate and define communications technology with few legacy constraints. The team develops and designs the Leo Government products and analyzes performance such as for overall throughput, latency, and system availability. This team also works closely with customers, business development and the engineering team to ensure that the product will meet customer requirements and presents a good business opportunity for Amazon Leo for Government.
   

  

 This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Work with business development and customers to help understand and refine their use cases and operational problems to solve
* Work with Engineering to invent new products or product features
* Write product roadmaps, product description documents, and engineering requirements documents for products and product families
* Create detailed product requirements documents based on an intimate knowledge of the specific customer verticals (local, state, federal, DoD, intelligence community) including use case prioritization, feature definition and product roadmap
* Work with leadership team to set the customer strategy and make appropriate high\-judgment trade\-offs between features and speed\-to\-launch
* Research and identify new opportunities to innovate on behalf of our customers
* Anticipate bottlenecks, manage risk and escalations, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* Space systems, satellite communications, and / or terrestrial networking experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics).

 In the spirit of reconciliation Amazon acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.
   

  

**IDE Statement**
 Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Role Summary**
**What I’ll be doing – your accountabilities**
 Own lifecycle operations for 4G/5G Enterprise Packet Core nodes. Also specialize in Nokia SR OS\-based IP/MPLS networks and NFM\-P operations: including audits, remediation, vendor coordination, and risk\-controlled upgrades. * Provides consultancy on network designs for multiple platforms and/or solutions and/or customers
* Develops design patterns across multiple domains.
* Responsible for establishing design best practice within a unit.
* Responsible for estimating the time and type of resource needed to support deliverables for complex, high impact and high value projects.
* Drives Right First\-Time solutions and leads lessons learned

* Potentially leads a large matrix team (virtual) and is accountable for complex network development using innovative approaches to design (including cross\-portfolio solutions). Leverages technical resource/s as required to deliver the solution.
* Decides on design scope and design to leading edge high impact and high\-risk network platforms and/or customer solutions
* Audit \& Install Base: inventory Packet Core Nodes, licenses, versions, dependencies
* Remediation: resolve routing/subscriber database/QoS issues, security baselines; troubleshoot EPC/5GC signaling/session problems and database replication
* Lifecycle Upgrades: plan/execute software upgrades (schema migrations, config freezes, interop testing) from lab → pilot → production
* Audit \& Install Base: inventory Nokia SR OS devices (7750/7705\), releases, line cards, license keys, HA, and NFM\-P components
* Service Audit: document L2/L3 VPNs, VPLS/EVPN, QoS policies, OAM, BFD, telemetry/alarms; validate compliance
* Remediation: resolve routing instabilities, LDP/RSVP/SR issues, QoS defects, MTU mismatches; fix HA/ISSU configurations
* Lifecycle Upgrades: plan/perform Nokia SR OS and NFM\-P upgrades/patches, using ISSU/hitless strategies where supported; manage pre/post checks and rollback
* Scripting \& Automation: automate audits/compliance and mass changes via MD\-CLI scripting, NETCONF/gNMI, Python/Ansible; integrate with NFM\-P APIs
* Risk Management: craft traffic reroute plans, staged upgrades, failover testing, and thorough rollback procedures
* Vendor Engagement: work with Cisco, NetNumber and Nokia teams on constraints, field notices and recommended upgrade paths; complete impact assessments
* Scripting \& Automation: build Ansible/Python playbooks for config validation, backups, compliance, health checks, and API\-based changes (NETCONF/RESTCONF)
* Risk Management: define change windows, traffic steering/bypass, rollback/fallback routing; maintain risk registers and detailed MOPs
* Security \& Compliance: lifecycle, segmentation, logging; track vulnerabilities and apply timely remediations

* Decides on network models for design testing.
* Decides on approach to resolving customer affected issues to leading edge high impact and high\-risk network platforms and/or customer solutions, as appropriate.
* Resolves in\-life issues to high risk and high impact network platforms and/or customer solutions, as appropriate
* Decides how to re\-use network designs.
* Decides on implementation approaches of technology related transformation activity.

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Mobile Network domain
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in IP Routing and IP/MPLS domain
* Strong understanding of 4G and 5G packet core domain
* Minimum 5\-8 years of hand on experience in Nokia 4G/5G CMU (Compact Mobility Unit) product.

* Lifecycle Upgrade Execution Plan (MOP): steps, validations, rollback, comms
* Risk Register: risks, impact assessment, mitigations
* Post\-Change Report: KPI deltas, incident summary, lessons learned
* Automation Assets: scripts/playbooks, runbooks, documentation


**Preferred / Bonus:**
* Cisco StarOS Specialist
* NetNumber Specialist
* Nokia CMU Specialist
* NOKIA SRC/NRP certifications: NRS II


**Experience You Would Be Expected To Have**
* Able to deliver significant stakeholder influence to resolve problems. Expected to give technical guidance to others to help resolve issues outside of the domain of the role.
* Acts as a point of contact for technical expertise to advise senior stakeholders, internal and external.
* Help to identify minimum data fields (across all stages) required from both customer and inventory systems from a technical designer perspective
* Identifying dependencies and system integration required to build the work\-flow and work with appropriate teams to get the same implemented.

The most complex problem will be platform wide, impacting multiple services (and include multiple vendors) or cross\-portfolio solutions.
* Impact of decisions are specific to the design strategy and/or direction for leading edge high risk and high impact network platforms and/or customer solution.
* Evidence of successful transformation measures – e.g. Network upgrade success rate with minimal customer impact.
* On\-time delivery of plans, risk assessments, and recommendations

 Prioritize customer needs in every decision and action.
   

  

**Challengers**
 Challenge the status quo and bring innovative ideas to life.
   

  

**Committed**
 Own outcomes and deliver with integrity.
   

  

**Clear**
 Communicate openly and simply, ensuring alignment.
   

  

**Connected**

**About The Role**
 The Customer Solutions Design Practitioner delivers end\-to\-end technical designs, ensuring that business requirements are successful translated into deliverable solutions, which meet customer needs whilst considering the impact of those solutions on all technical and business areas.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Essential Skills / Experience**
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Our Package**
 At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

ddfd63f2.title: Performance Testing - Experience Cloud Performance testing
ddfd63f2.description:
#### **Who We Are**



WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

### **The opportunity**



Job Title: Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, EDS, Adobe Commerce, Workfront \& Adobe Campaign) Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Performance Testing Consultant with expertise in Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Adobe Commerce, Adobe Workfront, and Adobe Campaign. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating and optimizing the scalability, responsiveness, reliability, and overall performance of digital experiences and marketing platforms, ensuring seamless customer engagement and business continuity. Key Responsibilities •Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, scalability, endurance, and capacity tests for Adobe Experience Cloud implementations. •Assess performance of AEM Sites, Assets, Forms, and Headless implementations, including authoring and publishing environments. •Validate Edge Delivery Services (EDS) performance, content delivery efficiency, caching strategies, Core Web Vitals, and page load behavior under varying traffic conditions. •Evaluate Adobe Commerce storefront, catalog, search, checkout, pricing, promotions, and order\-processing performance under peak workloads. •Test Adobe Workfront workflows, project management operations, integrations, reporting, and collaboration features for scalability and responsiveness. •Validate Adobe Campaign batch processing, audience segmentation, campaign execution, message delivery, workflow orchestration, and reporting workloads. •Analyze application and infrastructure performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and recommend optimizations. •Collaborate with solution architects, developers, DevOps engineers, and Adobe platform teams to resolve performance issues. •Monitor system behavior using observability and performance monitoring tools. •Develop performance baselines, service\-level objectives (SLOs), capacity planning recommendations, and optimization strategies.


### **What we can offer you**



Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.



Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.



We lead with **Heart**, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.  

We empower your **Brains** for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.  

And we champion **Courage**, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

#### **About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.



WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.



When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

c78b59e3.title: Manager, Solution Architect, Amazon Fuse
c78b59e3.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

  

The Amazon Fuse team creates convenience for our customers to experience Amazon services wherever they are by acquiring partner distribution for Amazon Subscriptions (e.g., Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited) and mobile applications (e.g., Shopping, Video, Music, Kindle, Photo\-Cloud Drive and Audible) around the world.  

  

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Manager, Solution Architect with deep technical expertise, business acumen, and strong leadership capabilities. This role combines the technical complexity of managing partner launches and integrations with the people leadership responsibility of building and scaling a high\-performing team of Technical Account Managers and Solution Architects.  

In this position, you will:  

* Lead a team of TAMs \& Solution Architects focused on managing technical relationships with key partners across multiple geographic locations
* Own the technical strategy and go\-to\-market approach for Fuse partner integrations and launches
* Develop world\-class technical talent while driving customer success and business growth
* Bridge the gap between partner requirements, Amazon product teams, and engineering organizations
* Establish technical thought leadership and serve as a strategic advisor to senior partner stakeholders


You will combine hands\-on technical leadership with people management, ensuring your team delivers exceptional results while continuously evolving in scope and capability. This role requires a self\-directed innovator who is a strong communicator, able to influence and motivate teams to action, with a proven track record of managing technical teams in fast\-paced, global environments.  

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI\-powered capabilities that accelerate decision\-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

People Leadership \& Team Development  

* Build and lead a high\-performing, diverse team of TAMs and SAs distributed across multiple geographic locations
* Manage performance, career development, and succession planning for team members, ensuring clear paths for growth
* Foster a culture of customer obsession, technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation
* Drive hiring excellence — define hiring bar, calibrate interviewers, and actively recruit top technical talent to scale the team
* Develop and retain world\-class technical talent through mentorship, skill development, and career advancement opportunities


Technical Strategy \& Customer Engagement  

* Own and manage the technical relationship of multiple partners across India and APAC, including the complete customer journey
* Define and execute the technical go\-to\-market strategy for Fuse solutions in assigned regions, in alignment with Business Development leadership
* Identify and drive improvements in Amazon products on behalf of assigned partners; act as primary stakeholder in providing requirements and use\-cases to Amazon product teams
* Partner with technical and business development teams to design solutions for customers and drive Fuse product adoption
* Engage directly with strategic partners at executive levels to drive large\-scale adoption of Fuse solutions and services
* Establish technical thought leadership through deep product knowledge, architectural discussions, and advisory engagement with key stakeholders


Solution Architecture \& Integration  

* Participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure partner success and scalability of integrations
* Provide technical consultation to strategic partners, including API integrations, design, creation, and deployment of Fuse products
* Dive deep into Fuse solutions and differentiators with customers and partners; be ready to discuss latest Fuse products, APIs, cloud architecture, and integration patterns
* Drive detailed discussions with partners on how Fuse integrates with their existing services; anticipate integration challenges and advise/influence to ensure successful outcomes
* Own the technical delivery plan once agreed, including status reporting, issue management, and accountability for timescales and delivery milestones
* Own all onboarding activities (APIs, Security Roles, test plans, systems integration)


Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Operations  

* Work with product and engineering teams to coordinate, scope, and prioritize new feature requests based on partner feedback
* Drive operational mechanisms (status reviews, business reviews, quarterly business reviews) to track team health, pipeline contribution, and partner success metrics
* Manage cross\-geographic coordination to ensure consistent execution, knowledge sharing, and effective support models across regions
* Collaborate with Sales and Business Development leadership on account coverage and specialist engagement models
* Partner with Service Teams to influence product roadmaps based on field feedback and customer requirements

  

About the team  

About the team
  

The Amazon Fuse team creates convenience for our customers to experience Amazon services wherever they are by acquiring partner distribution for Amazon Subscriptions (e.g., Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited) and mobile applications (e.g., Shopping, Video, Music, Kindle, Photo\-Cloud Drive and Audible) around the world.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree and 4\+ years of professional or military experience
* 8\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics).
* Experience leading global teams
* Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* • 3\+ years of experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals in customer\-facing roles
* • 3\+ years of deep experience managing technical teams of Solutions Architects, TAMs, Solutions Engineers, or equivalent technical customer\-facing roles
* • Proven experience architecting, designing, implementing, or consulting on applications and infrastructure solutions

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or equivalent
* Experience writing and publishing technical documents or equivalent
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture and AWS or comparable cloud platforms
* • Experience with data migration, modernization, and large\-scale transformation programs
* • Knowledge of cloud technology partner ecosystem and related products/services
* • Experience enabling partner ecosystems (resellers, system integrators, technology partners)
* • Experience in highly matrixed organizations, particularly working in alignment with BD and Partner teams

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

847bbc2e.title: Sr. Program Manager, WW FBA
847bbc2e.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The WW FBA team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.  

We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. There is a clear path for this role to evolve into full product ownership — including end\-to\-end responsibility for a defined FBA capability area — as the team and its scope grow. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country XBR forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions

  

Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years experience in program management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience in Amazon FBA, SCOT, inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* Familiarity with FBA inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller\-facing tools
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks
* MBA or Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

 workloads. You will be the primary architecture reviewer and performance champion for new data center clusters being built across multiple sites globally.

* Proven ability to evaluate and challenge infrastructure design decisions — including rack layout, power/cooling constraints, storage\-to\-compute distance, and network fabric topology.

 The WW FBA team is responsible for one of the most operationally complex challenges in Amazon's supply chain: ensuring the right inventory is in the right place at the right time, at the lowest possible cost, for sellers across every marketplace. Getting this right requires tight coordination across forecasting, placement, capacity, and seller behavior — and a clear line of sight into what is driving outcomes at the country level.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager who will partner closely with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams in International Emerging Stores (IES) stores to drive key FBA inventory metrics — covering areas such as inventory availability, excess/Aged inventory. In the near term, this role is focused on building the operating mechanisms, measurement frameworks, and cross\-functional alignment needed to move these metrics. Over time, as ownership matures, this person is expected to take on deeper accountability for metric outcomes, drive programs informed by experimentation and country\-level insights, and work directly with engineering, science, and BI teams to build scalable solutions. There is a clear path for this role to evolve into full product ownership — including end\-to\-end responsibility for a defined FBA capability area — as the team and its scope grow. You will need to be comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook — diagnosing problems using data you pull yourself, influencing teams you do not manage, and making decisions in the face of incomplete information. The ability to think in terms of systems, design experiments with sellers, and approach problems with an AI\-first mindset will be critical to succeeding in this role and growing it over time.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with in\-country FBA, SCOT, Retail, and Operations teams to drive key FBA inventory metrics taking progressively deeper ownership of outcomes over time.
* Build and maintain root\-cause attribution frameworks that connect upstream inputs (forecasting gaps, inbound defects, seller restock adoption, FC constraints) to downstream metric outcomes, enabling clear and consistent diagnosis across teams.
* Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly review mechanisms for your metric areas, representing FBA in country XBR forums and ensuring that system\-driven insights are correctly communicated and acted upon.
* Design and run structured experiments with sellers \- adoption levers, communication treatments, and incentive mechanisms, etc. and use findings to build an evidence\-based product and program roadmap.
* Work with Product, science, and BI teams to translate operational insights and experiment results into scalable product improvements; identify IES\-specific requirements and ensure they are reflected in WW roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve how metrics are tracked, root causes are diagnosed, and corrective actions are triggered.
* Coordinate peak readiness (Prime Day, BFCM) by identifying inventory risks early, stress\-testing operational workflows, and working with partner teams on mitigation plans.
* Serve as the connective tissue between WW FBA and in\-country stakeholders — validating hypotheses, surfacing local edge cases, supporting system rollouts, consolidating country\-specific inputs for OP1/OP2, and ensuring smooth knowledge transfer in both directions


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years experience in program management, supply chain analytics, business operations, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience owning business metrics end\-to\-end — defining measurement frameworks, diagnosing root causes, and leading cross\-functional teams to drive improvement
* Proficiency in SQL or equivalent querying tools to independently extract, analyze, and communicate operational insights without relying on a dedicated analytics resource
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing and presenting structured reviews to senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across teams you do not directly manage, in ambiguous or evolving organizational contexts
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation tools to redesign an analytical or operational workflow — not just familiarity with the concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in Amazon FBA, SCOT, inventory planning, or supply chain operations; or equivalent experience in marketplace or platform supply chain, or seller/vendor\-facing operations at scale
* Familiarity with FBA inventory systems — including placement logic, restock recommendations, capacity management, or seller\-facing tools
* Experience working in or closely with non\-US Amazon stores (EU, JP, IN)
* Demonstrated ability to build operating mechanisms from scratch — metric definitions, attribution frameworks, review cadences — in an environment without established playbooks
* MBA or Master's degree in a quantitative or technical field


**Basic Qualifications**

**Preferred Qualifications**

119f7d23.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solution Sales Engineer (Pre Sales) based in India.**
 This is a remote, customer\-facing opportunity for a technically strong sales professional supporting mid\-market and enterprise clients.
   

  

 You’ll bridge the gap between customer business needs, sales objectives, and technical product capabilities.
   

  

 The role combines solution consulting, technical demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and requirements analysis across data integration and enterprise systems.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with customers and sales teams to understand complex challenges and translate them into effective technical solutions.
   

  

 You’ll also collaborate with engineering teams to turn high\-level requirements into functional specifications and successfully delivered features.
   

  

 The position offers significant exposure to databases, data warehousing, APIs, CRM platforms, ERP integrations, and cloud\-based technologies.

* Prepare and deliver compelling technical presentations, product demonstrations, trials, and proof\-of\-concepts tailored to customer requirements.

* Good understanding of APIs and experience using tools such as Postman for testing and integration.

* Experience working with technology products and supporting enterprise or mid\-market customers.

* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible explanations for non\-technical stakeholders.

2afb9a73.title: Data Architect
2afb9a73.description:
**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years \|
 **Department:** 
 Data Engineering \|
 **Location:** 
 Dayal Infosystems
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 Dayal Infosystems is seeking a
 **Data Architect** 
 to lead the architecture, design, modernization, and lifecycle management of our enterprise data ecosystem. In this role, you will own the overarching data strategy across transactional databases, data warehouses, file systems, and data lakes supporting our core product suite.
   

  

 You will be responsible for bridging the gap between high\-throughput OLTP systems and modern analytical data platforms (OLAP/Lakehouse), ensuring ultra\-high availability, security, scalability, and performance across all product data layers.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise Data Architecture \& Modernization
* Architect, build, and maintain scalable data platforms, encompassing relational databases, NoSQL stores, object storage, modern data warehouses, and data lakes.
* Design and execute zero\-downtime database migration, consolidation, and modernization strategies across hybrid or cloud environments.
* Lead architecture patterns including OLTP vs. OLAP, CQRS, Read/Write Separation, Sharding, Distributed Databases, and Event\-Driven Architectures.
* Analytical \& Lakehouse Ecosystem
* Drive the design of modern analytical architecture (Medallion Architecture: Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) for product analytics and reporting.
* Architect real\-time and batch data pipelines utilizing Change Data Capture (CDC), Debezium, and Kafka for seamless integration between operational databases and analytical stores.
* Evaluate and implement modern Data Lakehouse frameworks, storage formats, and query engines.
* Database Engineering \& Performance Optimization
* Serve as the deep technical expert for core relational databases (with a heavy focus on MySQL 8\.x ecosystem and engine internals).
* Design robust High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), GTID Replication, and backup/restore strategies to ensure near\-zero RPO and RTO.
* Optimize complex SQL queries, index structures, schema designs, transaction models, locking strategies, and execution plans for mission\-critical production systems.
* Data Governance, Security \& Compliance
* Establish and enforce company\-wide data standards for security, compliance, data quality, lineage, and metadata management.
* Implement robust access controls including Least\-Privilege Access, Row\-Level Security (RLS), Column\-Level Security, encryption (at\-rest/in\-transit), data masking, and audit logging.
* Strategy, Operations \& Mentorship
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex, cross\-system performance bottlenecks and production incidents.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Product Leadership to align data capabilities with product roadmaps.
* Benchmark and evaluate emergent data technologies based on performance, cost efficiency, reliability, and scale.
* Mentor data engineers, DBAs, and software developers on schema design, query optimization, and architectural best practices.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
 Must Have
   

  

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in Database Engineering, Database Administration, and Data Architecture for enterprise\-grade product environments.
* Deep technical expertise in MySQL 8\.x (innodb mechanics, performance tuning, replication topologies, HA/DR setups).
* Proven track record in Data Architect roles, designing both transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Lake/Data Warehouse) systems at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with streaming \& CDC architectures (e.g., Kafka, Debezium, Canal, or similar tools).
* Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, distributed data storage, and modern file formats (Parquet, ORC, Avro, Delta/Iceberg).
* Expertise in database security controls (RLS, encryption, masking, auditing) and automated database management.
* Strong proficiency in Linux environments, shell scripting, and automation.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with multi\-database stacks: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, or ClickHouse.
* Experience with enterprise MySQL environments (MySQL Group Replication, Galera, Percona XtraDB Cluster).
* Deep experience with Cloud Native Database \& Analytics platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for data infrastructure (Terraform, Ansible) and Data Orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster).


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

3b8982fe.description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Fuse team creates convenience for our customers to experience Amazon services wherever they are by acquiring partner distribution for Amazon Subscriptions (e.g., Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited) and mobile applications (e.g., Shopping, Video, Music, Kindle, Photo\-Cloud Drive and Audible) around the world.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Manager, Solution Architect with deep technical expertise, business acumen, and strong leadership capabilities. This role combines the technical complexity of managing partner launches and integrations with the people leadership responsibility of building and scaling a high\-performing team of Technical Account Managers and Solution Architects.
   

  

**In This Position, You Will**
* Lead a team of TAMs \& Solution Architects focused on managing technical relationships with key partners across multiple geographic locations

* Develop world\-class technical talent while driving customer success and business growth
* Bridge the gap between partner requirements, Amazon product teams, and engineering organizations
* Establish technical thought leadership and serve as a strategic advisor to senior partner stakeholders


 You will combine hands\-on technical leadership with people management, ensuring your team delivers exceptional results while continuously evolving in scope and capability. This role requires a self\-directed innovator who is a strong communicator, able to influence and motivate teams to action, with a proven track record of managing technical teams in fast\-paced, global environments.
   

  

 At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI\-powered capabilities that accelerate decision\-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 People Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Build and lead a high\-performing, diverse team of TAMs and SAs distributed across multiple geographic locations
* Manage performance, career development, and succession planning for team members, ensuring clear paths for growth
* Foster a culture of customer obsession, technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation
* Drive hiring excellence — define hiring bar, calibrate interviewers, and actively recruit top technical talent to scale the team
* Develop and retain world\-class technical talent through mentorship, skill development, and career advancement opportunities


 Technical Strategy \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Own and manage the technical relationship of multiple partners across India and APAC, including the complete customer journey
* Define and execute the technical go\-to\-market strategy for Fuse solutions in assigned regions, in alignment with Business Development leadership
* Identify and drive improvements in Amazon products on behalf of assigned partners; act as primary stakeholder in providing requirements and use\-cases to Amazon product teams
* Partner with technical and business development teams to design solutions for customers and drive Fuse product adoption

* Own all onboarding activities (APIs, Security Roles, test plans, systems integration)

* Work with product and engineering teams to coordinate, scope, and prioritize new feature requests based on partner feedback

* Manage cross\-geographic coordination to ensure consistent execution, knowledge sharing, and effective support models across regions
* Collaborate with Sales and Business Development leadership on account coverage and specialist engagement models

 About the team
   

  

 The Amazon Fuse team creates convenience for our customers to experience Amazon services wherever they are by acquiring partner distribution for Amazon Subscriptions (e.g., Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited) and mobile applications (e.g., Shopping, Video, Music, Kindle, Photo\-Cloud Drive and Audible) around the world.

1. Conduct career guidance sessions, webinars, seminars, and workshops for students, parents, schools, and colleges to create awareness about career opportunities and academic pathways.

* The Program Manager becomes a trusted partner in enhancing student experience, driving program effectiveness, and supporting business growth through operational excellence.

7c8b7813.title: Presales Specialist
7c8b7813.description:
Datakrew is revolutionizing EV fleet intelligence with cutting\-edge IoT/AI solutions. Our flagship solution, OXRED Platform Suite, provides deep insights into vehicle fleet performance and diagnostics. Datakrew is backed by leading global investors including Beenext and SG Growth Capital,we serve customers across 8\+ countries in Asia, including Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, and India, and are now expanding into the UK and Europe. Our goal is to serve one million EVs within the next 5 years, and as a company, touch a billion lives with technology. 
 



  





**Job Overview:** 




  





 We’re hiring a Pre\-Sales Specialist to build and run the outbound engine behind Datakrew’s global growth. You will own a continuous, multi\-geography pipeline engine and the qualification discipline that turns what it generates into genuine opportunities, supporting field sales across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia as the team grows. This is currently a single position, and the scope is designed to expand as the field sales team expands. You will be the connective tissue between marketing, field sales, customers, and the technical team, keeping a healthy, self\-sustaining pipeline running in every market, not just the ones getting hands\-on attention this week.
 



 Own the outbound engine that builds Datakrew’s pipeline across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 What will you own from Day 1
 


* Own and operate the automated, multi\-geography cold outbound engine that builds and sustains pipeline continuously across regions, replacing one\-to\-one manual outreach with a repeatable, always\-on system.
* Qualify leads into genuine Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) by applying consistent qualification criteria before handing opportunities to field sales.
* Partner with the Digital Marketing / Marketing Execution function to keep ownership clean: Marketing owns inbound demand\-gen and MQL campaigns; this role owns targeted, account\-level outbound and qualification into SQL.
* Maintain CRM and outbound\-tooling hygiene with accurate, up\-to\-date activity, account intelligence, and qualification data
* Track and report pipeline generation volume, MQL→SQL conversion, and deal velocity across all supported regions.



  





 What this role grows into
 



  





 As the field sales team expands across regions, the scope of this role expands with it. These become part of the remit as the pipeline engine matures and beds in:
 


* Deep account intelligence (buying\-committee mapping, competitive positioning, use\-case fit) so field sales can run a consultative, insight\-led process rather than a generic pitch.
* Techno\-commercial proposals tailored to client needs, decision criteria, and business objectives.
* Coordination across customers, field sales, and engineering, with quick\-turnaround customisation of proposals and decks as deals progress.
* Continuous learning of Datakrew’s evolving technology and product offerings.



  





**Required skills:** 




  




* 5–7 years in B2B pre\-sales, inside sales, or demand generation, including at least 2 years hands\-on building and running automated outbound campaigns. SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience in EV, automotive, or battery tech is a strong plus.
* Depth in multi\-channel outbound (email and LinkedIn) using email automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), covering list building, cadence design, copy testing, and deliverability. This is core to the role, not incidental.
* Aptitude for account research and building actionable account intelligence (buying committee, competitive landscape, use\-case fit). Depth here can be developed in the role.
* Strong qualification discipline, able to apply consistent criteria to convert leads into genuine SQLs rather than pass volume downstream.
* Working knowledge of software integration concepts, APIs, and hardware\-software integration.
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen, able to translate technical concepts into business language and vice versa.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication, with cultural adaptability across geographies (UK, Europe, Southeast Asia).
* Comfort with outbound copywriting and A/B testing of messaging and cadence to improve response rates.
* Ability to build repeatable process, this role's remit is designed to grow in scope alongside field sales as the team expands, so process discipline matters as much as individual execution
* High ownership, quick learning, and comfort working independently in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional, multi\-geography environment.



  





**Good to have:** 




  




* Prior experience engaging with EV OEMs, automotive fleets, or IoT platforms
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce) and data enrichment / prospecting tools(e.g., Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
* Awareness of email deliverability best practices (domain warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC basics) and outreach compliance considerations (GDPR, CAN\-SPAM) across regions, since this role's outbound engine spans UK/Europe and Asia.
* Exposure to AI\-driven analytics or SaaS\-based platforms.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Direct, visible impact on strategic accounts and global growth, this role sits at the centre of the GTM engine, not on its edge.
* Learning, advancement, and leadership opportunities within a cutting\-edge AI \+ IoT company.
* Flexible work setup and autonomy in execution.

d8b43b10.title: Gen AI Architect
d8b43b10.description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 We're seeking an experienced GenAI/AI Architect to lead the design and implementation of enterprise\-scale artificial intelligence solutions. You'll own the complete architecture journey—from strategy through production deployment—working across technical and business teams to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to navigate complex organizational landscapes and emerging technology trends.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Design end\-to\-end architectures for production\-grade GenAI/AI systems, establishing reference architectures and reusable patterns for enterprise adoption
* Evaluate and recommend large language models, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks based on performance, cost, compliance, and security requirements
* Architect retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows, and multi\-agent systems for scalable deployment
* Collaborate with data scientists, security teams, developers, and business leaders to align technical solutions with organizational needs
* Embed governance, privacy, and ethical frameworks into AI systems from design through deployment
* Guide teams on model lifecycle management, including deployment strategies, monitoring, performance optimization, and handling model drift
* Evaluate tools and frameworks for system integration and interoperability
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native AI services and optimize for scalability and performance
* Stay informed on GenAI/AI advancements and regulations, translating insights into actionable strategic roadmaps


**The skills you bring:**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, statistics, engineering, or related field
* Proven track record architecting large\-scale AI/ML systems in production environments
* Deep expertise in Python, machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), and deep learning practices
* Strong knowledge of large language model architectures, fine\-tuning techniques, and deployment strategies
* Hands\-on experience with RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases
* Familiarity with agentic GenAI frameworks and integration protocols
* Cloud architecture experience (AWS, Azure) and container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes)
* Solid understanding of MLOps principles: CI/CD pipelines, observability, model governance, and retraining workflows
* Ability to communicate complex AI strategies effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated commitment to responsible AI, including governance and ethical considerations
* Bonus: Experience scaling AI solutions in telecom or similar complex enterprise environments
