c0ef3a58.description:
**Job Description**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong enterprise architecture capability from business and industry strategy through solution design, delivery and value realisation. They will combine large\-scale transformation experience with practical knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Fusion Applications and Industry Solutions delivered through Oracle’s Global Industry Units (GIUs).
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
* Credibility and influence with senior business and technology executives, including C\-suite stakeholders.
* A cross\-industry perspective and the ability to translate industry trends, operating models and regulatory pressures into customer value propositions.
* Deep knowledge of at least one industry vertical is advantageous, supported by the ability to work effectively across industries.
* Strong enterprise architecture skills across business, data, application, integration, cloud and technology domains, with a pragmatic and adaptable approach to methods and frameworks.
* Ability to create integrated architectures across OCI, Fusion Applications and Oracle industry solutions / GIUs, including the dependencies between them.
* Working knowledge of AI, generative AI and agentic AI concepts, opportunities, risks, governance and responsible adoption in enterprise environments.
* Ability to support multiple parallel strategic engagements across complex customer, partner and sales environments.
* A successful record in consultative presales, pursuit leadership and development of strategic proposals and business cases.
* Ability to facilitate executive workshops and communicate clearly in small working sessions and large customer forums.
* Commercial acumen, negotiation capability and the ability to articulate business value, risk reduction and time\-to\-value.
* Ability to lead virtual teams and influence stakeholders across direct and indirect reporting lines to deliver complex customer outcomes.


**Responsibilities**
**Core solution expertise**
 You will demonstrate broad enterprise architecture depth and strong capability in several of the following areas:
   

  

* Fusion Applications architecture and transformation, including two or more functional domains such as ERP, EPM, HCM, SCM or CX.
* OCI architecture, cloud platform services, security, resilience, integration, data platforms and modern application development.
* Industry solutions and GIU offerings, with the ability to position industry\-specific capabilities alongside horizontal Oracle services.
* AI architecture and adoption, including generative AI, AI agents, data foundations, governance, security, responsible AI and measurable business outcomes.
* Data, analytics and information management, including modern data platforms, integration patterns, data quality and insights\-driven operating models.
* End\-to\-end process, service and information integration across complex hybrid and multi\-cloud application environments.
* Enterprise security, identity, privacy, compliance and operational resilience incorporated by design into solution architecture.
* Industry domain depth in a sector such as public sector, financial services, health, utilities, telecommunications, retail, manufacturing or hospitality.


**Leadership and delivery capability**
* Business transformation, operating\-model design and value\-realisation planning.
* Programme leadership, governance and benefits management for complex, multi\-workstream initiatives.
* Application, data, cloud or infrastructure implementation and change management.
* Customer adoption, organisational change and stakeholder management.
* Application portfolio modernisation and rationalisation.
* Commercial modelling, investment cases and lifecycle cost considerations for technology and business change.
* Partner ecosystem engagement and orchestration of Oracle and customer delivery teams.
* Thought leadership, reusable architecture assets and continuous learning across Oracle’s evolving portfolio.
* A commitment to developing inclusive, secure and responsible technology solutions that deliver measurable customer value.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

710db5c7.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
710db5c7.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 InsurTech is Expedia Group’s team for
 **insurance and assurance products** 
 . It identifies, incubates, and scales products that drive revenue and fit into the traveler journey, and it owns the end\-to\-end technology strategy and execution for those products.
   

  

 In practice, the team builds reusable shop/book/serve capabilities for insurance and fintech offerings across Expedia brands, and focuses on things like supply integration, checkout, servicing, claims, content, experimentation, and ML/data platforms.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead the definition, planning, and delivery of complex, multi\-team technical programs across the Insurtech organization, with a focus on Insurance and embedded flexibility products, ensuring clear problem framing, measurable outcomes, and alignment to Expedia Group’s strategic objectives.
* Drive innovative programs that improve the traveler experience while delivering significant impact to a P\&L business within Expedia Group, translating strategy into executable roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable business and customer outcomes.
* Drive end\-to\-end program execution by establishing program structures, roadmaps, and success metrics; proactively identifying cross\-team dependencies; and resolving risks and issues to maintain predictable delivery across engineering, product, business, and partner stakeholders.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to shape technical solutions, including system design, API contracts, and data flows, and ensure design decisions support scalability, resilience, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with supplier partners and cross\-functional teams across global markets to deliver customer and commercial value at scale, align priorities, and accelerate execution across a distributed ecosystem.
* Create and operate effective governance and communication mechanisms, including steering forums, technical reviews, and decision logs, that provide transparency, enable timely trade\-offs, and keep executives, partner organizations, and stakeholders informed and engaged.
* Drive breakthrough and 0\-to\-1 product development outcomes by enabling experimentation, validating new opportunities, and helping teams turn emerging concepts into scalable products and platform capabilities.
* Champion and implement best practices in technical program management at scale, including standardized planning, execution, and operational excellence practices, while mentoring other TPMs and influencing how programs are run across the broader organization.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes by coordinating experimentation, rollout, and monitoring plans, and ensuring teams have the practices and controls needed to use AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows responsibly and effectively.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience leading complex technology initiatives.
* Extensive experience (typically 10\+ years) in technical program management, software engineering, or a closely related discipline, including ownership of large, cross\-team, or multi\-service programs in a technology organization.
* Proven ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams on technical topics such as distributed system design, API design, data modeling, and integration patterns, and to translate technical details into clear, outcome\-focused plans.
* Demonstrated success driving programs from concept through launch and ongoing iteration, including definition of measurable objectives, risk and dependency management, and establishing mechanisms for tracking and reporting progress at scale.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including partnering with engineering and data teams to ensure such capabilities are integrated and operated safely and effectively within program scope.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Track record of leading multi\-quarter, multi\-team technical transformations, platform initiatives, or 0\-to\-1 product programs, operating at organization or domain scale and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes across product, engineering, and business teams.
* Experience delivering in highly regulated product environments, with the ability to incorporate compliance, risk, privacy, security, and operational control requirements into program planning, execution, and decision\-making.
* Strong experience with B2C program and product development, including delivering customer\-facing capabilities that improve user experience, drive adoption, and balance customer value with measurable business outcomes.
* Deep experience influencing technical direction through program work, including coordinating architectural reviews, driving alignment on system and API design decisions, and ensuring data models and integration approaches enable long\-term extensibility, reuse, and partner interoperability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with external partners, suppliers, and third\-party providers, aligning joint roadmaps, managing dependencies, and delivering shared outcomes across internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ability to design and improve program operating models and execution frameworks, including mechanisms that enhance reliability, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement for large\-scale, customer\-facing systems.
* Strong data\-driven decision\-making skills, including defining and instrumenting key technical and business metrics, using data to assess program health and trade\-offs, and adjusting plans based on empirical evidence, experimentation results, and evolving market or partner inputs.
* Safely integrates and operates AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, with experience steering AI/ML\-related programs such as personalization, automation, or decision\-support capabilities, including responsible use guardrails, evaluation methods, and collaboration with specialized AI/ML teams.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
   

  

**Important notice**
 Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

**Enterprise Database Architect** 




  





**Company Background** 




 Actian is a global leader in hybrid data management, cloud data warehousing, and data integration technologies. Trusted by world\-class organizations such as Bloomberg, Intuit, Lufthansa, and Citibank, we help businesses solve their most complex data challenges and drive transformation through innovative solutions. Actian puts our greatest asset, our people, at the centre and offers employees the opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment focused on shared success. At Actian, we believe in culture add and dont subscribe to ideologies limiting peoples potential. We don’t want people to work here – we want them to belong here.
 



 With a vision of being the most trusted, flexible, and easy\-to\-use data platform, our product portfolio includes the most performant data management, data integration, and data analytics products on the market. Customers use our cloud\-native data platform to unify their data, explore and securely exchange data to run various analytic workloads that provide real\-time business insights at a fraction of the cost. Twenty\-four (24\) Fortune 100 companies use Actian technology in some of the most mission\-critical applications that impact your daily life.
 



 Actian helps organizations confidently transform their business by simplifying how people manage and govern data for AI and beyond.
 



 Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity as we shape this market.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 We are looking for a Sales Engineer with a proven track record in selling Database and Data Analytics solutions with a background in Database Management. This individual utilizes their knowledge in the data world to partner with the Sales team and function as the key technical point of contact for software deals, providing pre\-sales support contributing towards the successful conversion of prospects to customers. A significant portion of the Sales Engineer role includes scoping, defining, and providing demonstrations and executing Proof\-of\-Concepts. This includes working with the customers and partners to gain an understanding of their business and its needs, mapping our offerings to those needs, and providing competitive analysis that assists with the successful positioning of our offerings.
 



 This person has a broad range of skills and experience in data management, analytics and vector databases. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Actian’s solution, the customer\-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to provide consultative assistance on architecture and trusted technical advisor.
 



 This person also shares our vision about reinventing the data world and thrives in the dynamic environment. That means having the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get done what needs to be done to make Actian and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever\-evolving technologies for data and analytics to be an authoritative resource for Actian and our customers. And it means working collaboratively with a broad variety of people both inside and outside the company.
 



 As we move into the world of database technology to support AI, this role will also open opportunities into exciting technologies that Actian will be bringing to market
 



  





**What You Will Be Doing** 



* Be a technical guide on all aspects of Actian – with a primary focus on Database management, data analytics and AI.
* Collaborate with the Sales team to find and close new business opportunities
* Provide strategic pre\-sales support for sales activities including needs analysis, technology review, requirements definition, and scoping
* Create and deliver world\-class product presentations and demonstrations to meet prospect, customer, or internal needs
* Work with customers on proof\-of\-concept projects in a competitive environment
* Maintain deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Actian in relation to them
* Provide guidance on how to resolve customer\-specific technical challenges
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Actian’s products and marketing.
* Researching companies and prospects to identify business issues and needs, and providing results of that research to customers to support our recommendations
* Become an expert in our products’ features, benefits, presentations, and application to customer needs
* Provide proactive support to customers and prospects with the goal of facilitating sales
* Establish and maintain positive customer relationships, and follow\-up on opportunities
* Be the customer advocate and liaison for product management and development
* Other related duties as assigned



  





**What You Bring to Actian** 



* Minimum 5 years of experience working with customers in a pre\-sales or post\-sales technical role
* Bachelor’s, or higher, in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos
* Strong skills in databases, data warehouses, and data processing
* Extensive hands\-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics
* Experience and track record of success selling data and/or analytics software to enterprise customers; includes proven skills identifying key stakeholders, winning value propositions, and compelling events
* Experience with relational and large\-scale analytics database technology (e.g. Oracle, Informix, SQL Server, Snowflake, Netezza, Teradata, etc.)
* Experience with AI vector databases (e.g. pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma etc.)
* Experience of the modern AI stack (Infrastructure, Orchestration \& Frameworks as well as AI governance)
* Experience and understanding of large\-scale infrastructure\-as\-a\-service platforms (e.g. Google Cloud Platform, Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure)

***Like to have***

**Why Join Actian**

**Experience:** 6–8 Years  
**Employment Mode:** C2H

**Location:** Chennai \| Hyderabad \| Bangalore

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Kafka Architect** with 6–8 years of expertise in designing, implementing, and managing highly available, scalable, secure, and reliable **Apache Kafka platforms**.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Kafka architecture, Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, Schema Registry, DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and event\-driven architectures**.

* Optimize Kafka cluster performance, throughput, capacity, and reliability.
* Implement Kafka security using **SSL/TLS, SASL, ACLs, authentication, authorization, and encryption**.
* Monitor Kafka clusters and proactively troubleshoot performance and production issues.
* Ensure Kafka platform **high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery**.
* Automate Kafka deployment, configuration, and operational activities using **DevOps tools and Infrastructure as Code**.
* Work with **Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, and Terraform** for automation and deployment.
* Establish Kafka governance, architecture standards, best practices, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, DevOps, and application teams to implement **event\-driven solutions**.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance for Kafka implementations.
* Create and maintain technical architecture documents, operational procedures, and implementation guidelines.
* Mentor development and engineering teams on Kafka best practices and enterprise messaging patterns.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **6–8 years of overall IT experience** with strong hands\-on experience in Apache Kafka.
* Strong expertise in **Apache Kafka** architecture and administration.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Kafka Connect
* Kafka Streams
* Schema Registry
* ZooKeeper / KRaft
* Kafka Producers \& Consumers
* Strong understanding of **Kafka clusters, topics, partitions, replication, retention, and capacity planning**.
* Experience with **Linux and Java**.
* Experience with **GitLab CI/CD and DevOps automation**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Kubernetes / OpenShift**.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
* Experience implementing Kafka security using **SSL/TLS, SASL, ACLs, and encryption**.
* Strong understanding of **high\-availability and disaster\-recovery architectures**.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as **Prometheus and Grafana**.
* Strong knowledge of networking, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience with **event\-driven architecture and enterprise messaging solutions**.

**DevOps \& Automation Skills**

The candidate should have experience with one or more of the following:

* GitLab CI/CD
* Jenkins
* Docker
* Kubernetes / OpenShift
* Ansible
* Terraform
* Infrastructure as Code
* Automated Kafka deployment and configuration

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience designing Kafka platforms for **large\-scale enterprise environments**.
* Experience with multi\-cluster and multi\-region Kafka architectures.
* Experience with Kafka disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
* Experience with cloud\-native Kafka deployments.
* Knowledge of Confluent Kafka ecosystem.
* Experience working with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams in Agile environments.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on **Kafka Architect** capable of designing enterprise\-grade Kafka platforms, implementing secure and highly available architectures, optimizing Kafka performance, and automating platform operations through **DevOps and CI/CD practices**.

Strong experience in **Kafka \+ GitLab CI/CD \+ DevOps \+ Kubernetes \+ Cloud \+ Event\-Driven Architecture** is highly preferred.

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹130,000\.00 per month

ba6c5fa4.title: AI lead/Architect
ba6c5fa4.description:
Job Description AI Center of Excellence Lead AI Engineer \& Solution Architect Role
 



  





 Summary:
 



  





 We are looking for a hybrid AI Engineer and Solution Architect to lead our AI Center of Excellence (CoE). This is a working lead role, not a purely managerial one — it requires someone who can design and build production LLM/RAG and agentic systems personally, while also setting the technical direction, standards, and delivery discipline for the team building them. The ideal candidate has a strong core software engineering foundation (full\-stack / .NET or equivalent enterprise stack) and has since specialized into applied AI.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Lead the AI Center of Excellence: define the team’s technical standards, reusable patterns, and reference architecture for GenAI/Agentic AI delivery across engagements.
 



 ● Architect and build end\-to\-end GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, multi\-agent workflows — from design through production deployment.
 



 ● Own solution architecture across the full stack: backend services, APIs/microservices, data layer, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring AI components integrate cleanly with existing enterprise systems.
 



 ● Select and justify the technical stack — LLM providers, vector databases, orchestration frameworks — based on the problem, not on default habit, and codify these choices as CoE guidelines.
 



 ● Produce architecture artifacts (HLD/LLD, sequence diagrams, integration specs) that the team builds against, and review their designs for architectural soundness.
 



 ● Build in evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring for AI systems — hallucination checks, retrieval quality metrics, human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths — as a standard the CoE enforces, not a one\-off step.
 



 ● Support presales and solutioning — translating client requirements into a credible technical approach and effort estimate, and representing the CoE in client\-facing technical discussions.
 



 ● Mentor and technically lead the team, growing its GenAI capability and setting the bar for what “production\-ready” means.
 



  





 Required Skills — AI / GenAI
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, or equivalent) and prompt engineering for production use cases.
 



 ● RAG architecture — chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking — and the trade\-offs between them.
 



 ● Agentic AI patterns: tool\-calling, planner/executor designs, multi\-agent orchestration (LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent).
 



 ● Vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, pgvector, or equivalent) and semantic search implementation.
 



 ● Working ML/DL fundamentals — comfortable evaluating when a classical model or fine\-tuning approach is the better answer than an LLM call.
 



 ● Python as the primary language for AI/ML work. Required Skills — Engineering \& Architecture
 



 ● Strong core software engineering background, with proficiency in .NET/C\# and/or Java (Spring/Spring Boot) at an architecture level, not just scripting.
 



 ● REST API and microservices design; comfortable defining service boundaries and contracts.
 



 ● Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) — deployment, scaling, and security basics for production services.
 



 ● SQL and NoSQL database design; understands when each is the right fit.
 



 ● Containerization and CI/CD (Docker and a standard pipeline tool).
 



 ● Demonstrated solution architecture experience — has owned HLD/LLD for at least one non\-trivial system, not just contributed to one.
 



  





 Experience \& Profile
 



  





 ● 12–17\+ years overall in software engineering, with a clear architecture or technical\-lead track record.
 



 ● At least 2–3 years of recent, hands\-on GenAI/Agentic AI project experience — not certifications alone.
 



 ● Comfortable operating in a client\-facing, presales\-adjacent capacity when needed.

23d532dd.title: Senior Staff Consulting Architect- Cloud Native Services -Kubernetes
23d532dd.description:
**Role Overview**


Nutanix is seeking a **Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – Cloud Native** to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native platforms based on the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), across virtualized, bare\-metal, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.


The role is intended for a highly experienced cloud\-native architect who can operate as a **trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders**, lead complex and strategic platform transformation initiatives, and define scalable architecture standards across large and distributed environments.


The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.


The role will also be responsible for developing **reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs**, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud\-native capability of the consulting organization.


Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Enterprise Architecture \& Strategic Advisory**

* Provide **end\-to\-end architecture leadership** for complex enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native transformation programs.
* Define strategic platform architectures spanning:
	+ Nutanix AHV
	+ VMware vSphere
	+ Bare metal
	+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure
	+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
	+ Edge and distributed infrastructure
* Lead architecture strategy for large\-scale and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Translate business, application, infrastructure, security, and operational requirements into scalable and resilient cloud\-native architectures.
* Define target\-state architectures and **multi\-phase transformation roadmaps** covering platform adoption, application modernization, migration, automation, and operations.
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, platform engineering teams, and DevOps organizations on cloud\-native adoption strategies.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and technology selection criteria for enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for complex architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and escalations.

**2\. Advanced Kubernetes \& Platform Architecture**

* Architect enterprise NKP platforms at scale, including:
	+ Multi\-cluster and fleet architectures
	+ Multi\-tenancy and workload isolation
	+ High availability and disaster recovery
	+ Cluster lifecycle management
	+ Platform scalability and capacity planning
	+ Security and governance
* Define advanced Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Design virtualization\-aware Kubernetes platforms considering:
	+ Compute and resource allocation
	+ NUMA and CPU topology
	+ Storage performance
	+ Network architecture
	+ Failure domains
	+ Cluster density
	+ Performance optimization
* Define architecture patterns for GPU\-enabled and AI/ML workloads where applicable.
* Architect integration between Kubernetes and enterprise services including:
	+ DNS
	+ LDAP/Active Directory
	+ PKI and certificate management
	+ Load balancers
	+ Backup and disaster recovery
	+ Enterprise monitoring and logging
* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.

**3\. Complex Transformation \& Delivery Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership for high\-value and technically complex customer engagements from **Day\-0 architecture through Day\-2 operations**.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:
	+ Platform deployment
	+ Cluster onboarding
	+ Application migration
	+ Application modernization
	+ Platform integration
	+ Operational transformation
* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:
	+ Kubernetes
	+ Hypervisors
	+ Networking
	+ Storage
	+ Security
	+ Automation
	+ CI/CD
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.

**4\. Automation, GitOps \& Platform Engineering**

* Define enterprise automation strategies for Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms.
* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:
	+ GitHub Actions
	+ GitLab CI
	+ Jenkins
	+ Argo CD
	+ Tekton
	+ Flux CD
* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:
	+ Terraform
	+ Ansible
* Define automation patterns integrating:
	+ NKP APIs
	+ Kubernetes APIs
	+ Nutanix APIs
	+ VMware APIs
	+ AWS/Azure APIs
* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self\-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version\-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.

**5\. Security, Governance, Resilience \& Operations**

* Define enterprise security architecture across infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application platform layers.
* Establish security and governance models covering:
	+ RBAC
	+ Network policies
	+ Pod Security Standards
	+ Secrets and certificate management
	+ Policy\-as\-Code
	+ Workload isolation
	+ Multi\-tenancy
* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:
	+ Observability
	+ Logging
	+ Monitoring
	+ Backup and recovery
	+ Disaster recovery
	+ Business continuity
* Establish operational models covering platform lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity management, and resilience.
* Review platform performance, scalability, and operational maturity and drive continuous optimization.

**6\. Technical Leadership, Mentoring \& Capability Development**

* Serve as a **technical authority and escalation point** for the Cloud Native consulting organization.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects, Consulting Architects, and other technical consultants.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical coaching on complex customer engagements.
* Develop and deliver internal technical enablement programs covering Kubernetes, NKP, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native architecture.
* Define competency expectations and technical development paths for cloud\-native architects.
* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leadership to establish targeted upskilling programs.
* Promote engineering and consulting best practices across geographies and delivery teams.

**7\. Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership**

* Create and maintain enterprise\-grade reference architectures, design patterns, deployment frameworks, and technical playbooks for cloud\-native platforms.
* Develop reusable consulting assets that improve delivery quality, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to Nutanix cloud\-native solutions.
* Drive innovation in areas such as:
	+ Kubernetes platform engineering
	+ Multi\-cluster management
	+ GitOps
	+ AI/ML platforms
	+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
	+ Application modernization
	+ Hybrid/multi\-cloud
	+ Developer platforms
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and other technical teams to provide field feedback and influence product direction.
* Represent the consulting organization in technical forums, customer executive discussions, architecture communities, and industry events where appropriate.
* Contribute to whitepapers, technical blogs, solution briefs, and other thought\-leadership content.

**Technical Skills \& Experience**

**Mandatory Skills – Must Have**

* **15\+ years of experience** across infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, or related technologies.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering large\-scale enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
	+ Nutanix AHV
	+ VMware vSphere
	+ Bare\-metal infrastructure
* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture across:
	+ Compute

	+ Networking
	+ Virtualization
	+ Security
* Strong experience with Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes networking, storage, security, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Deep expertise in:
	+ Load balancers
	+ SSL/TLS and certificate management
	+ LDAP/Active Directory
	+ DNS
	+ Backup and DR
	+ Enterprise observability
* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD and GitOps platforms.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code:
	+ Terraform
	+ Ansible
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes APIs, infrastructure APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Proven experience designing multi\-cluster, highly available, resilient, and secure Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, automation, and application platform layers.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements and architecture decisions.
* Excellent customer\-facing, consulting, presentation, and executive communication skills.

**Added Advantage – Good to Have**

* Strong experience with public cloud Kubernetes services:
	+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
	+ Amazon EKS
* Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud architecture.
* Experience with Kubernetes fleet/multi\-cluster management.
* Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
* Experience with service mesh technologies.
* Experience with GPU\-enabled Kubernetes and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and custom automation.
* Experience with application modernization and containerization.
* Experience with FinOps, capacity planning, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience influencing product strategy or working directly with product/engineering organizations.

**Trainable / Developable Skills**

* Advanced NKP capabilities and emerging Nutanix cloud\-native technologies.
* Advanced AI/ML platform architecture and GPU orchestration.
* Emerging Kubernetes ecosystem technologies.
* Advanced platform engineering and developer experience frameworks.
* Advanced multi\-cloud governance and FinOps.
* New automation frameworks and cloud\-native tooling.

**Leadership \& Consulting Expectations**


The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect is expected to demonstrate the ability to:

* Operate effectively at C\-level, executive, enterprise architect, and senior technical stakeholder levels.
* Lead architecture decisions across multiple technology domains and organizational boundaries.
* Influence without direct authority.
* Challenge existing architecture assumptions and recommend pragmatic alternatives.
* Balance technical excellence with business outcomes, delivery timelines, operational complexity, and cost.
* Establish technical direction for complex and strategic customer programs.
* Independently handle ambiguous and high\-impact technical problems.
* Mentor other architects and elevate the technical maturity of the broader consulting organization.
* Convert field experience into reusable architecture patterns, methodologies, and intellectual property.

**Education \& Certifications**

**Education**

**Preferred Certifications**

* Nutanix certifications:
	+ NCP

	+ NCX
* VMware certifications:
	+ VCP
	+ VCAP/VCIX preferred
* Terraform Associate or equivalent
* Ansible Automation certification
* Relevant AWS/Azure certifications

**Location \& Work Shifts**

* Pune – Work from Office
* Travel as required for customer assignments

26e785e2.title: Senior Staff Consulting Architect- Cloud Native Services -Kubernetes
26e785e2.description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Nutanix is seeking a Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – Cloud Native to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native platforms based on the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), across virtualized, bare\-metal, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 The role is intended for a highly experienced cloud\-native architect who can operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead complex and strategic platform transformation initiatives, and define scalable architecture standards across large and distributed environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 The role will also be responsible for developing reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud\-native capability of the consulting organization.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Strategic Advisory
* Provide end\-to\-end architecture leadership for complex enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native transformation programs.
* Define strategic platform architectures spanning:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare metal
+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure
+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
+ Edge and distributed infrastructure

* Lead architecture strategy for large\-scale and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Translate business, application, infrastructure, security, and operational requirements into scalable and resilient cloud\-native architectures.
* Define target\-state architectures and multi\-phase transformation roadmaps covering platform adoption, application modernization, migration, automation, and operations.
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, platform engineering teams, and DevOps organizations on cloud\-native adoption strategies.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and technology selection criteria for enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for complex architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and escalations.
* Advanced Kubernetes \& Platform Architecture
* Architect enterprise NKP platforms at scale, including:
+ Multi\-cluster and fleet architectures
+ Multi\-tenancy and workload isolation
+ High availability and disaster recovery
+ Cluster lifecycle management
+ Platform scalability and capacity planning
+ Security and governance

* Define advanced Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Design virtualization\-aware Kubernetes platforms considering:
+ Compute and resource allocation
+ NUMA and CPU topology
+ Storage performance
+ Network architecture
+ Failure domains
+ Cluster density
+ Performance optimization

* Define architecture patterns for GPU\-enabled and AI/ML workloads where applicable.
* Architect integration between Kubernetes and enterprise services including:
+ DNS
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ PKI and certificate management
+ Load balancers
+ Backup and disaster recovery
+ Enterprise monitoring and logging

* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.
* Complex Transformation \& Delivery Leadership
* Provide technical leadership for high\-value and technically complex customer engagements from Day\-0 architecture through Day\-2 operations.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:
+ Platform deployment
+ Cluster onboarding
+ Application migration
+ Application modernization
+ Platform integration
+ Operational transformation

* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:
+ Kubernetes
+ Hypervisors
+ Networking
+ Storage
+ Security
+ Automation
+ CI/CD

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.
* Automation, GitOps \& Platform Engineering
* Define enterprise automation strategies for Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms.
* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:
+ GitHub Actions
+ GitLab CI
+ Jenkins
+ Argo CD
+ Tekton
+ Flux CD

* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Define automation patterns integrating:
+ NKP APIs
+ Kubernetes APIs
+ Nutanix APIs
+ VMware APIs
+ AWS/Azure APIs

* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self\-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version\-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.
* Security, Governance, Resilience \& Operations
* Define enterprise security architecture across infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application platform layers.
* Establish security and governance models covering:
+ RBAC
+ Network policies
+ Pod Security Standards
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Policy\-as\-Code
+ Workload isolation
+ Multi\-tenancy

* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:
+ Observability
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Backup and recovery
+ Disaster recovery
+ Business continuity

* Establish operational models covering platform lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity management, and resilience.
* Review platform performance, scalability, and operational maturity and drive continuous optimization.
* Technical Leadership, Mentoring \& Capability Development
* Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for the Cloud Native consulting organization.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects, Consulting Architects, and other technical consultants.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical coaching on complex customer engagements.
* Develop and deliver internal technical enablement programs covering Kubernetes, NKP, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native architecture.
* Define competency expectations and technical development paths for cloud\-native architects.
* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leadership to establish targeted upskilling programs.
* Promote engineering and consulting best practices across geographies and delivery teams.
* Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership
* Create and maintain enterprise\-grade reference architectures, design patterns, deployment frameworks, and technical playbooks for cloud\-native platforms.
* Develop reusable consulting assets that improve delivery quality, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to Nutanix cloud\-native solutions.
* Drive innovation in areas such as:
+ Kubernetes platform engineering
+ Multi\-cluster management
+ GitOps
+ AI/ML platforms
+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
+ Application modernization
+ Hybrid/multi\-cloud
+ Developer platforms

* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and other technical teams to provide field feedback and influence product direction.
* Represent the consulting organization in technical forums, customer executive discussions, architecture communities, and industry events where appropriate.
* Contribute to whitepapers, technical blogs, solution briefs, and other thought\-leadership content.


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory Skills – Must Have
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience across infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, or related technologies.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering large\-scale enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare\-metal infrastructure

* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture across:
+ Compute
+ Storage
+ Networking
+ Virtualization
+ Security

* Strong experience with Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes networking, storage, security, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Deep expertise in:
+ Load balancers
+ SSL/TLS and certificate management
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ DNS
+ Backup and DR
+ Enterprise observability

* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD and GitOps platforms.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Strong understanding of Kubernetes APIs, infrastructure APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Proven experience designing multi\-cluster, highly available, resilient, and secure Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, automation, and application platform layers.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements and architecture decisions.
* Excellent customer\-facing, consulting, presentation, and executive communication skills.


 Added Advantage – Good to Have
   

  

* Strong experience with public cloud Kubernetes services:
+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
+ Amazon EKS

* Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud architecture.
* Experience with Kubernetes fleet/multi\-cluster management.
* Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
* Experience with service mesh technologies.
* Experience with GPU\-enabled Kubernetes and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and custom automation.
* Experience with application modernization and containerization.
* Experience with FinOps, capacity planning, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience influencing product strategy or working directly with product/engineering organizations.


 Trainable / Developable Skills
   

  

* Advanced NKP capabilities and emerging Nutanix cloud\-native technologies.
* Advanced AI/ML platform architecture and GPU orchestration.
* Emerging Kubernetes ecosystem technologies.
* Advanced platform engineering and developer experience frameworks.
* Advanced multi\-cloud governance and FinOps.
* New automation frameworks and cloud\-native tooling.


 Leadership \& Consulting Expectations
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect is expected to demonstrate the ability to:
   

  

* Operate effectively at C\-level, executive, enterprise architect, and senior technical stakeholder levels.
* Lead architecture decisions across multiple technology domains and organizational boundaries.
* Influence without direct authority.
* Challenge existing architecture assumptions and recommend pragmatic alternatives.
* Balance technical excellence with business outcomes, delivery timelines, operational complexity, and cost.
* Establish technical direction for complex and strategic customer programs.
* Independently handle ambiguous and high\-impact technical problems.
* Mentor other architects and elevate the technical maturity of the broader consulting organization.
* Convert field experience into reusable architecture patterns, methodologies, and intellectual property.


 Education \& Certifications
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is an advantage.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Nutanix certifications:
+ NCP
+ NKP
+ NCX

* VMware certifications:
+ VCP
+ VCAP/VCIX preferred

* Terraform Associate or equivalent
* Ansible Automation certification
* Relevant AWS/Azure certifications


 Location \& Work Shifts
   

  

* Pune – Work from Office
* Travel as required for customer assignments
* Willingness to work US and EMEA shifts based on customer and engagement requirements


 \-\-

d17367d5.description:
**About Tekion:** 




 Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



 Job Introduction
 



 The Senior Technical Program Manager drives large\-scale, cross\-functional technical initiatives that are critical to Tekion’s business and product strategy. This role is responsible for end\-to\-end program leadership, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and operational teams while delivering complex programs on time and within scope. The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with strong technical depth, stakeholder management experience, and a track record of delivering in high\-growth environments.
 



  





 Key Role \& Responsibilities
 


* Lead the execution of high\-impact technical programs involving multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and other functions to define scope, success metrics, and delivery plans
* Identify and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs; escalate as needed to unblock progress
* Establish clear operating cadences, including status reporting, stakeholder communication, and executive updates
* Drive clarity and accountability across workstreams, ensuring alignment with company goals and product milestones
* Mentor junior TPMs and contribute to developing best practices, templates, and tools for the TPM function
* Influence strategic planning and roadmapping with a program\-centric execution lens



  





 Basic Qualifications
 


* 6–8 years of experience in technical program management, software delivery, or engineering leadership
* Proven track record of leading complex technical programs in fast\-paced or high\-growth environments
* Deep understanding of software development, system architecture, and agile methodologies
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, conflict resolution, and communication skills
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and other project management and collaboration tools
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., PMP, SAFe) a plus



  





 Perks \& Benefits
 



  




* Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale.
* Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud\-native \& AI driven platform.
* Innovative, collaborative, and fast\-paced culture.

**Presales Coordinator** 




  





 About Hexnode
 



 Hexnode is a
 **global leader in Unified Endpoint Management (UEM)** 
 , trusted by over 100 countries and managing millions of devices worldwide. With a rapid pace of innovation, we have established ourselves as a dominant force across Apple, Windows, Android, macOS, Linux, and tvOS.

 Hexnode is a rare combination of global scale, product excellence, and startup\-level velocity. We operate in a mission\-critical category—supporting organizations that rely on secure, reliable device management every single day.  As a Presales Coordinator, you will support the team by managing complex bid processes, coordinating technical responses, and ensuring seamless day\-to\-day operations.  Conduct Discovery \& Whiteboard Sessions to develop new use\-cases

 Guide customers with hands\-on help and best practice to drive operational maturity of their Confluent Deployment
   

  

 Analyze Customer Consumption trends and identify Optimization opportunities
   

  

 Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, and serve as a key Product advocate across the Customer, Partner and Industry ecosystem
   

  

 Forge strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as a dependable partner for them
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Solutions Engineering or similar work experience
   

  

 Experience with Open Source Flink
   

  

 Experience with Event\-Driven architecture, Data Integration \& Processing Techniques, Database \& Data Warehouse technologies
   

  

 First\-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment \& Application Development
   

  

 Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes
   

  

 Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL
   

  

 Technical certifications \- Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering \& Integration
   

  

 Clear, consistent demonstration of self\-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems
   

  

 Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities.
   

  

 Confidence presenting to a highly skilled and experienced audience, ranging from developers to enterprise architects and up to C\-level executives

1f545d6f.title: Solution Consultant II
1f545d6f.description:
**Why UKG**
 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

 About Us: UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) is an industry market leader known for leveraging cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize workforce management. As we continue to expand our product footprint globally, we are creating new opportunities in India. Join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of providing innovative solutions that empower businesses and employees alike.
   

  

 Role Overview: As a Solution Consultant II at UKG, you will play a pivotal role in delivering superior workforce management solutions to our clients. You will be accountable for your own success, utilizing your expert knowledge of workforce management software to design and implement solutions that maximize benefits for our customers. Your superior communication and presentation skills, coupled with your ability to manage complex environments and client relationships, will ensure your success in this role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Requirement Assessment: Conduct workshops with senior members of customer organizations to drive requirement assessments.
* Solution Design: Architect comprehensive solutions that integrate UKG Pro WFM (Dimensions) with third\-party products, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Customization and Integration: Design and implement customizations and integrations to meet specific client needs.
* Documentation: Collect, analyze, validate, and document business requirements, creating detailed technical specifications for the implementation team.
* Build and Configuration: Oversee the build and configuration of the system, ensuring adherence to the original design and client requirements. Provide expert knowledge and best practices during the Build phase.
* Testing Support: Provide guidance and support during the testing phase, including functional testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Best Practices: Advocate for and implement industry best practices in workforce management, process optimization, and system configuration.
* Effective Communication: Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders using use cases, visual diagrams, and process flow charts.
* Client Management: Foster strong relationships with client Project teams, acting as a trusted advisor and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.
* Mentoring: Mentor and provide guidance to team members on advanced modules and solutioning aspects.
* Travel: Travel up to 25% may be required to meet with clients and support project implementations.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Sciences or a related field.
* Experience:
* 3\- 6 yrs years of experience implementing or supporting enterprise software applications and hardware used in web environments (UKG Pro WFM/Workday/Ceridian/Oracle/PeopleSoft/SAP Human Resources/Payroll/Time and Labor).
* 3\+ years of experience in Workforce Management is a must.
* Relevant experience as a consultant in a similar application environment is desirable.
* Extensive experience in implementing solutions for medium to large enterprise customers.
* Skills:
* Thorough understanding of business, process, and technology relating to workforce management.
* Experience with requirement gathering, solution designing, implementing, and configuring UKG Products.
* Extensive experience on UKG Pro WFM (Dimensions) modules like Time Keeping, Accruals, Leave, Advanced Scheduling, Forecasting, Attendance and Activities is desirable.
* Prior experience in supporting functional testing, integration testing, and UAT.
* Demonstrated track record in delivering quality, on\-time technology and business solutions to a diverse customer base.
* Solid interpersonal skills to interface with co\-workers and customers, managing specific tasks to completion with minimal direction.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


 If you are a seasoned professional with a passion for workforce management and a track record of delivering high\-quality solutions, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and be a part of our exciting journey at UKG!
   

  

**Company Overview**
 UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.
   

  

 UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.
   

  

 Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process
   

  

 For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com

* Ensure strong controls around:

* Generative AI for reporting, insights, and automation

* Identify and implement use cases to transform legacy processes using AI
* Foster a culture of innovation and experimentation with emerging AI technologies.


3\. Business–Technology Liaison

* Serve as the primary interface between Business and Technology teams.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear technical solutions and vice versa.
* Communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, including executives and leadership teams.
* Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams and ensure successful delivery outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 15\+ years in Asset Management and Performance Analytics
* Strong expertise in:
* Performance Analytics \& Attribution
* Portfolio data models and investment lifecycle
* Proven experience with:
* Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Lakehouse architecture

	+ Ability to influence without authority and lead cross\-functional teams
	+ Strategic thinker with a hands\-on execution mindset
	+ Passion for innovation and continuous improvement

**Preferred Qualifications**


Experience with investment platforms (e.g., Aladdin, Charles River, FactSet, Vermillion, Seismic)

* Familiarity with:
	+ Data orchestration tools (Tidal, TWS)
	+ Exposure to APIs and event\-driven architectures
	+ Certifications in cloud, data engineering, or AI will be a plus

 **In\-Office Collaboration**  

We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. a022cf1d.title: Principal Solutions Consultant — Managed Services (India)
a022cf1d.description:
**About the Company**  

Keka is a SaaS HRMS platform, helping companies manage the entire employee lifecycle efficiently– hiring, onboarding, time \& attendance, payroll, performance, and learning in one integrated system.
We have been in the market for 10\+ years and currently serve around ten thousand clients in India, US and GCC. **Context**  

Keka is standing up its Managed Services (MS) business. MS is not a BPO — it is Keka running the customer's payroll, statutory, and HR operations on the Keka HRMS platform they already have (or would move to). Same platform, same data, same employee experience, new operating model.
This role is focused on the India market — ENT \+ MM segments. You will be the country expert in every MS prospect call for India logos, from IND ENT Farming (large existing base) to Regular ENT and MNC/GCC merged Hunting motions. **About the Role** **Solutioning is your primary responsibility.** You are the India country expert who owns Payroll / Statutory / Time \& Attendance depth for the market. You sit in prospect calls, create need for MS, defend and shape scope, and push deals through to closure. You are not a passive expert — you carry the deal.  

Beyond Solutioning, you partner across three functions to make sure the motion holds together: GTM (support and enable Sales), Product (bridge to R\&D on functional gaps), and Delivery (track project health post\-signature). You do not execute delivery or own partnerships — those live elsewhere. Your job is to close deals and make sure closed deals stay healthy. **Primary Responsibility \- Solutioning**  

**Country Expertise*** **Statutory framework depth.** EPF (12% \+ 12%), ESI (3\.25% \+ 0\.75%), state\-wise Professional Tax (KA/MH/WB/TS/AP/TN/GJ/KL/MP/OR), LWF (applicable states), TDS Section 192 across regimes (old vs new), Gratuity, Bonus. Filing calendars: monthly ECR \+ challan \+ TRRN (by 15th), TDS challan (by 7th), Form 24Q quarterly, Form 16 by June 15, Form 12BA annual.
* **Payroll components.** Gross\-to\-net mechanics, salary structures, reimbursements, garnishments, F\&F settlements, prior\-vendor cleanup patterns.
* **Time \& Attendance.** Attendance\-to\-payroll pipelines, overtime rules, PTO / leave policy design, statutory paid leave.
* **Compliance rhythm.** Notice triage cadence, audit prep, peak\-load moments (year\-end, statutory season) that customers panic about.

 **Sales\-Call presence*** **Create need.** Walk a prospect through their own pain in ways they had not articulated. Turn "we already do payroll" into "we already lose Ops leaders to payroll."
* **Defend and shape scope.** Hold the SKU line where it matters; concede where it wins the deal. Know the difference cold.
* **Carry the technical narrative from first\-call to signed MSA.** RFP responses, security questionnaires, statutory Q\&A, delivery walk\-throughs.
* **Competitive positioning.** Displacement plays against ADP India, greytHR, Zoho Payroll, Ramco, Neeyamo, Darwinbox, Zeta, and enterprise incumbents like SAP SuccessFactors \+ PeopleStrong — know each competitor's weak spots cold.

 **Secondary Responsibilities**  

**GTM \- Support and enable*** Enable Sales (Farming \+ Hunting) with talk tracks, objection handling, and country\-specific scope walkthroughs — delivered via the Enablement team.
* Contribute to MS content the Marketing team produces: pitch decks, scope\-by\-SKU 2\-pagers, displacement battlecards, case studies. Ensure the content is factually correct and prospect\-tested.
* Feed back what is landing and what is not from prospect calls, so content and positioning evolve on a fast cadence.

 **Product \- bridge, not build*** Translate recurring prospect and delivery pain into structured Product requirements (not anecdotes).
* Track those requirements through Product's roadmap. When a Product gap blocks an MS deal, pull it forward with a data\-backed case.
* When Product ships something useful, get it into pitch decks and battlecards within a week.

 **Delivery \- track, not execute*** Monitor delivery health on the accounts you closed — cycle accuracy, SLA adherence, escalations, renewal signals.
* Flag risks to Delivery leads early; hand off cleanly and stay available as escalation backup.
* Own the debrief when a deal closes — what did we sell, what does Delivery need to deliver, where are the known risks.

 **What you bring*** **Deep payroll expertise for India.** You can walk any prospect through statutory framework, filing calendars, and edge cases without notes.
* **6\+ years in HR Tech, payroll, or global employer\-of\-record.** Ideally split between hands\-on delivery and client\-facing / commercial roles. Companies like Keka, Darwinbox, greytHR, Zoho Payroll, RazorpayX Payroll, Zeta, Ramco, springworks, Neeyamo (India) are the right shape of pedigree.
* **Sales\-call fluency.** You have sat in front of CHROs, CFOs, and Heads of People and closed. You know when to push and when to concede scope.
* **Strong communication** — written and verbal. Comfortable running executive\-level prospect calls.
* **Numeracy and structured thinking.** Comfortable with pricing math and SKU logic; can build your own analysis when the ask is ambiguous.

 **Nice to have**  

* Multi\-country payroll implementation exposure.
* Formal certifications — CPP / FPC (US), Certified Payroll Manager (India), or geo equivalents.
* Experience contributing to battlecards, competitive positioning, or sales playbooks.
* **Bonus depth** in ENT\-scale multi\-state deals or MNC/GCC captive payrolls.

bff67c2a.title: Sr.Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business, Private Brands, Recommerce
bff67c2a.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Our organization spans three distinct Amazon India businesses — Amazon Business (comprising Self\-Service Registered / SSR and CPS enterprise sales), Private Brands, and ReCommerce — each on a multi\-million\-dollar, WW\-leading growth trajectory. Delivering that growth depends on executing large, complex, cross\-organizational programs across CX, SX, sales, tech, pricing, supply chain, and operations, often with dependencies on Worldwide and partner teams. Increasingly, the most valuable of these programs are AI\-powered — agentic buying assistants, AI\-driven pricing and selection, intelligent automation across returns and recovery — so AI fluency is central to the role, even as the mandate spans the full breadth of the org's most critical programs.  

  

We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the most critical and complex programs across the portfolio, with a primary focus on Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) and targeted support for the largest, highest\-complexity programs in Private Brands and ReCommerce. This is a senior, cross\-cutting role spanning three separate businesses: you will drive alignment across engineering, product, and business leaders.Many of these programs are customer\-facing AI products; others are platform, pricing, expansion, supply\-chain, or compliance programs — you will own the hardest ones regardless of type.  

  

You will inherit a portfolio of the org's marquee initiatives. Success looks like complex programs delivered on time across team boundaries, dependencies sequenced before they become blockers, and leadership given a single, trusted view of program health.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the largest and most complex programs in Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) — the primary focus of the role — driving them end\-to\-end from definition through launch across engineering, product, pricing, GTMO/sales, and operations. These span customer\-facing AI products as well as platform, pricing, expansion, and compliance programs.  

  

Lead delivery of customer\-facing AI experiences where they are on the critical path — turning fast\-moving AI capabilities into shipped products with clear customer value — while applying the same rigor to the org's other complex, high\-stakes programs.  

  

Provide targeted program leadership to Private Brands and ReCommerce — two separate businesses — for their largest and most complex initiatives only, prioritizing where cross\-org complexity and business impact are highest.  

  

Drive cross\-business and cross\-org dependency management — identify, sequence, and unblock the dependencies (tech, data, model/evaluation readiness, tax/accounting, supply chain, WW partner teams) that cause complex programs to slip.  

  

Establish and run program governance — mechanisms, status reporting, and leadership reviews that give each business a single view of health, risk, and critical path.  

  

Be an AI\-forward operator. Use GenAI and internal AI tooling extensively to accelerate planning, synthesize status, model dependencies, and compress work that traditionally took days into hours — and help raise the bar on how the broader team adopts AI in program management.  

  

Partner with SDMs and business leaders across all three businesses to convert strategy (OP1/OP2, 3YF/LRF) into sequenced, resourced, executable plans, and mentor other PMs/TPMs on execution rigor.  

  

A day in the life  

You start with AI as your co\-pilot — synthesizing overnight status across your programs and flagging the two dependencies now on the critical path. Mid\-morning, you run a program review with an SSR and a CPS engineering team building a customer\-facing agentic assistant, locking sequencing on the evaluation and guardrail work that gates launch. Switching context to a separate business, you align a Private Brands pricing\-program lead and a WW partner team on a stalled funding\-and\-timeline decision — a program that has nothing to do with AI but everything to do with cross\-org complexity. In the afternoon you prep the portfolio health view for your leadership review, escalating one complex ReCommerce program at risk with options and a recommendation. You close by shaping the plan for a newly greenlit, high\-complexity Amazon Business initiative — defining scope, dependencies, and critical path before it kicks off.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
