b1315c31.title: Medical AI Research Program Manager @Amritapuri
b1315c31.description:
Job Title Medical AI Research Program Manager Required Number 1 Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, biomedical/life sciences, healthcare, management, or a related field
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary, technical, research, or healthcare projects
* Working literacy in machine\-learning workflows — data collection, annotation, training, evaluation, validation. You won't build models, but you must be able to follow (and question) a discussion about them.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* The ability to turn broad, ambiguous objectives into clear, actionable plans


 Job Description
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Seeking applications from candidates who can lead multidisciplinary AI healthcare projects, coordinate clinicians and engineers, manage timelines, publications, and deliver AI solutions that improve patient care. Job responsibilities include:
   

  

* Running the engineering cadence. Daily stand\-ups with the ML team, sprint planning, retrospectives — keeping five engineers (plus student researchers) unblocked, prioritized, and honest about progress.
* Running the clinical interface. Doctors join us every two weeks. You prepare those meetings, capture what the clinicians actually need (which is not always what they first say), and translate it into requirements engineers can build against — then translate results back into language clinicians trust.
* Owning the plans. Turning ambiguous research goals ("can we predict severity from these videos?") into milestones, owners, and timelines — and updating them when reality disagrees, which it will.
* Protecting the deadlines. Conference submissions run this lab's calendar. You track them, work back from them, and raise the alarm early when a project is quietly drifting off course.
* Sharpening the output. Reviewing manuscripts, reports, and proposals for clarity and consistency. You are often the last set of eyes before something leaves the building.
* Asking the uncomfortable question. When a result looks too good, when two people are measuring different things, when "almost done" has been almost done for three weeks — noticing is your job. You don't need to solve the technical problem; you need to make sure it can't hide.

Solution architecture \& design

Data connectivity \& modeling

0f13cdb1.title: Principal Solutions Consultant — Managed Services (USA)
0f13cdb1.description:
**About The Company**
 Keka is a SaaS HRMS platform, helping companies manage the entire employee lifecycle efficiently– hiring, onboarding, time \& attendance, payroll, performance, and learning in one integrated system.
   

  

 We have been in the market for 10\+ years and currently serve around ten thousand clients in India, US and GCC.
   

  

**Context**
 Keka is standing up its Managed Services (MS) business. MS is not a BPO — it is Keka running the customer's payroll, statutory, and HR operations on the Keka HRMS platform they already have (or would move to). Same platform, same data, same employee experience, new operating model.
   

  

 This role is focused on the India market — ENT \+ MM segments. You will be the country expert in every MS prospect call for India logos, from IND ENT Farming (large existing base) to Regular ENT and MNC/GCC merged Hunting motions.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Solutioning is your primary responsibility.** 
 You are the US country expert who owns Payroll / Statutory / Time \& Attendance depth for the market. You sit in prospect calls, create need for MS, defend and shape scope, and push deals through to closure. You are not a passive expert — you carry the deal.
   

  

 Beyond Solutioning, you partner across three functions to make sure the motion holds together: GTM (support and enable Sales), Product (bridge to R\&D on functional gaps), and Delivery (track project health post\-signature). You do not execute delivery or own partnerships — those live elsewhere. Your job is to close deals and make sure closed deals stay healthy.
   

  

**Primary Responsibility \- Solutioning**
**Country Expertise**
* Statutory framework depth. Federal (FIT, FICA, FUTA), multi\-state (SIT \+ SUI across 50 states \+ DC, reciprocity), CheckHQ\-supported local taxes (NYC, Philadelphia, SF), state\-specific payroll taxes (CA SDI, NY MTA, OR TriMet, WA WBF). Filing calendars: Form 941 quarterly, Form 940 annual, W\-2 / W\-3, 1099\-NEC / MISC by Jan 31, EFTPS deposits.
* Payroll components. Gross\-to\-net mechanics, salary structures, reimbursements, garnishments, F\&F settlements, prior\-vendor cleanup patterns.
* Time \& Attendance. Attendance\-to\-payroll pipelines, overtime rules, PTO / leave policy design, statutory paid leave.
* Compliance rhythm. Notice triage cadence, audit prep, peak\-load moments (year\-end, statutory season) that customers panic about.


**Sales\-Call presence**
* Create need. Walk a prospect through their own pain in ways they had not articulated. Turn "we already do payroll" into "we already lose Ops leaders to payroll."
* Defend and shape scope. Hold the SKU line where it matters; concede where it wins the deal. Know the difference cold.
* Carry the technical narrative from first\-call to signed MSA. RFP responses, security questionnaires, statutory Q\&A, delivery walk\-throughs.
* Competitive positioning. Displacement plays against ADP, Paychex, Gusto, Rippling, Justworks, Deel, Papaya, Trinet, Paylocity, Paycom, Paycor — know each competitor's weak spots cold.


**Secondary Responsibilities**
**GTM \- Support and enable**
* Enable Sales (Farming \+ Hunting) with talk tracks, objection handling, and country\-specific scope walkthroughs — delivered via the Enablement team.
* Contribute to MS content the Marketing team produces: pitch decks, scope\-by\-SKU 2\-pagers, displacement battlecards, case studies. Ensure the content is factually correct and prospect\-tested.
* Feed back what is landing and what is not from prospect calls, so content and positioning evolve on a fast cadence.


**Product \- bridge, not build**
* Translate recurring prospect and delivery pain into structured Product requirements (not anecdotes).
* Track those requirements through Product's roadmap. When a Product gap blocks an MS deal, pull it forward with a data\-backed case.
* When Product ships something useful, get it into pitch decks and battlecards within a week.


**Delivery \- track, not execute**
* Monitor delivery health on the accounts you closed — cycle accuracy, SLA adherence, escalations, renewal signals.
* Flag risks to Delivery leads early; hand off cleanly and stay available as escalation backup.
* Own the debrief when a deal closes — what did we sell, what does Delivery need to deliver, where are the known risks.


**What You Bring**
* Deep payroll expertise for US. You can walk any prospect through statutory framework, filing calendars, and edge cases without notes.
* 6\+ years in HR Tech, payroll, or global employer\-of\-record. Ideally split between hands\-on delivery and client\-facing / commercial roles. Companies like Gusto, Rippling, Justworks, Deel, Papaya Global, Trinet, Paylocity, Paycom, Paycor, ADP (SBS or NAS side) are the right shape of pedigree.
* Sales\-call fluency. You have sat in front of CHROs, CFOs, and Heads of People and closed. You know when to push and when to concede scope.
* Strong communication — written and verbal. Comfortable running executive\-level prospect calls.
* Numeracy and structured thinking. Comfortable with pricing math and SKU logic; can build your own analysis when the ask is ambiguous.


**Nice to have**
* Multi\-country payroll implementation exposure.
* Formal certifications — CPP / FPC (US), Certified Payroll Manager (India), or geo equivalents.
* Experience contributing to battlecards, competitive positioning, or sales playbooks.
* Bonus depth in multi\-country deals with US\-HQ anchors or exposure to Ceridian / Dayforce, Workday Payroll.

fa093b90.description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced and motivated Senior Solutions Architect with deep expertise in SaaS\-based Software\-Defined Vehicles (SDV), connected\-vehicle platforms, and cloud\-native automotive systems. Serving as a trusted technical advisor, you will partner with global OEMs and ecosystem partners to architect scalable, secure, and resilient SDV solutions using the Sibros Deep Connected Platform. In this role, you will bridge technical capabilities with business strategy across vehicle\-to\-cloud connectivity, edge\-to\-cloud data pipelines, digital twins, predictive maintenance, and over\-the\-air (OTA) update programs.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Drive Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for Automotive OEM accounts across India, EU, and Japan, engaging directly with engineering leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Architect Scalable Platforms: Architect and design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions for industry\-specific workloads, including connected vehicle systems and SDV data platforms.
* Execute Pre\-Sales \& PoCs: Lead proof\-of\-concept (PoC) engagements, conduct architectural reviews, and actively support customer RFP processes to de\-risk production deployments and drive key opportunities through to closure.
* Lead Custom Solutions: Lead and manage a team of developers to design and deliver custom, customer\-focused solutions, leveraging AI\-assisted tools to improve development speed, quality, and innovation.
* Bridge Enterprise Systems: Direct integrations with enterprise software ecosystems, including MES, PLM, After Sales Systems, SAP, and custom cloud integration workflows.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Work closely with customer engineering teams as well as internal Sibros Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Success teams to translate business objectives into deployable technical solutions.


 What You Should Know
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Domain \& Systems Expertise: 15\+ years of experience across specific technology domain areas, including software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, networking, security, and data analytics.
* Architecture \& Design: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud applications and infrastructure architectures.
* Automotive Data Infrastructure: Working knowledge of real\-time and batch data processing at scale, using technologies like MQTT, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, time\-series databases, and data analytics tools applied to connected vehicles.
* Cloud \& Edge Technologies: Working knowledge of major hyperscalers (e.g., AWS, GCP), IoT/edge computing, data lakes, AI/ML, HPC, and DevOps/CI\-CD pipelines.
* Stakeholder Communication: Proven capability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and non\-technical executive stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cross\-Domain Integration: Hands\-on experience integrating cloud\-native SDV architectures with legacy OEM software and enterprise enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP).
* Team \& Innovation Management: Background in leading developer teams with a modern focus on AI\-assisted development tooling to accelerate release cycles.
* Global OEM Exposure: Familiarity navigating complex multi\-region technical requirements and delivery models across India, EU, and Japan markets.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


****Equal Opportunity Employer****
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Location: Noida, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

 The Delivery Manager is responsible for the delivery of all Customization and Integration PS services and offers Globally for the CDI/CSP business unit. The Delivery Manager partners with Sales, Sales Engineers, Presales team, Legal team, product management, engineering, training and business development teams by accurately gathering customers technical and business requirements and determining and positioning the most appropriate services and internal resources.
   

  

 This is a management role with some element of hands\-on technical deployment/delivery role backing up the team members, requiring extensive and significant experience in managing Services teams, within a dynamic environment. 50% of your time will be spent on managerial duties as coaching team members and performance management. The candidates will have to demonstrate a proven track record of success, in managing/coaching software development teams in a development/integration environment, and also business development along with optimizing revenue for a Professional Services entity.
   

  

 Primary responsibilities include:

* Ensure proper delivery timelines and take appropriate actions to meet defined revenue targets

* Responsible for identification of new business opportunities via new deals or Change requests.
* Process creation, control and implementation based on best ITIL practices.


**Qualification Requirements:**
**Experience:**
* B.S. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS or equivalent preferred
* Extensive experience in professional services, software development or customer application/integration support operations, related with IT security
* Proven track record of technical team management experience
* Extensive customer facing experience in a technical or project management role
* Proven experience of systems integration and/or implementation preferred
* Proven solutions consulting experience in large enterprises


**Skills:**
 Key skills required for the position:
   

  

* Strong coaching skills within multi\-cultural environment and across regions

* High energy, flexible, pro\-active and excellent resistance to stress

### **Description**

  

Vena Solutions is looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Product and Technology Operations team and play a critical role in how we deliver at scale. This role is responsible for driving cross\-team alignment and execution of complex, high\-impact initiatives that span multiple development teams. As a TPM, you will own the planning, coordination, and delivery of shared technical initiatives—managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and timelines to ensure successful outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and leadership teams to maintain alignment and visibility, ensuring our most important technical investments deliver meaningful business and customer value.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross\-team technical initiatives from inception through completion
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, timelines, success metrics, and resource alignment for shared technical programs
* Drive alignment on goals, priorities, and sequencing across multiple development teams with competing demands
* Identify, manage, and proactively escalate inter\-team dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges
* Serve as the central point of coordination between platform teams, product teams, and enabling functions
* Facilitate effective cross\-functional collaboration through regular planning, dependency, and delivery ceremonies
* Provide clear, consistent visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes through status reporting and stakeholder communications
* Partner with engineering, product, and leadership to ensure delivered initiatives meet quality standards and achieve intended business and customer impact

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* **5\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management at a B2B SaaS company**
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives
* Strong technical fluency and understanding of technical concepts such as APIs, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD process, etc.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and project management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies, risks, and trade\-offs across multiple teams
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence and align both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments with competing priorities
* **Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI\-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies**

### **About Vena Solutions**


At Vena, we’re reimagining how businesses plan and grow: powered by data, collaboration, and innovation  

  

Headquartered in Toronto with a global reach, we help finance teams work smarter using the tools they already love (yes, we’re talking about Excel!). Trusted by over 1,800 organizations and 150,000\+ users every day, Vena Solutions brings clarity to complexity.  

  

We're a people led company that leads with our CORE values (Customer Trust, One Team, Respect \& Authenticity and Execution Excellence) and are driven by our mission

Your well\-being \= our priority! Great health \& dental plans, wellness sessions (virtual \& in\-person), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a free Headspace subscription to support your mental health.
Vena is everywhere you are! With offices in **Toronto**, **London**, and **Indore**, as well as team members across the United States, EMEA and beyond, we're a truly global company. Collaborate with colleagues around the world and bring diverse ideas to life: no passport required!

With modern workspaces in Toronto, Indore, and London, we offer inspiring environments when you need them \- and the freedom to work in ways that work best for you and your team.
At Vena, we don’t just keep up, we're leading the way!

By fostering a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use, we’re building a future where AI enhances how we work, think, and lead. From automating workflows to enhancing insights, AI is woven into everything we do.

729500f5.description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
Job Summary
  
  

The Data Architect will play a key leadership and architecture role across two major areas: Application Data Migration and the subsequent design and implementation of the enterprise Data Platform .
  
  

The role will be responsible for analyzing complex application data migration requirements, defining the end\-to\-end migration architecture and approach, guiding execution and testing, and ensuring successful transition of data from legacy/source applications to target systems.
  
  

Following the migration program, the Data Architect will lead the architecture and implementation of the target Data Platform, including data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines, data storage and processing capabilities, reporting and analytics solutions, and enterprise data governance capabilities such as data cataloging, lineage, security, quality, and metadata management.
  
  

The role requires strong architecture expertise combined with hands\-on understanding of data engineering, migration, analytics, and data governance, as well as the ability to work closely with business, application, infrastructure, security, and implementation teams.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

Significant experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Data Migration, and enterprise Data Platform implementation.
  
  

Proven experience designing and delivering application data migration programs.
  
  

Strong understanding of relational databases, data models, data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, and analytical platforms.
  
  

Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT architecture, data integration patterns, APIs, batch processing, Change Data Capture, and data orchestration.
  
  

Experience designing scalable cloud data platforms on MS Fabric.
  
  

Strong understanding of data migration methodologies, source\-to\-target mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and migration testing.
  
  

Experience with enterprise BI and analytical architectures, including semantic models, data marts, reporting, and dashboards.
  
  

Strong understanding of data governance concepts including data cataloging, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, data ownership, and stewardship.
  
  

Strong knowledge of data security, privacy, data classification, access control, encryption, masking, and regulatory considerations.

 e.Hevo runs real\-time data pipelines from 150\+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goal

 **.**

 **e.**

 **et.**

 is realStrong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding\-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is signi
 **ficant.**

2. to end.Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).

 **roadmap.**

1. 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.

5a544dc0.description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 Step into a pivotal role on Avalara’s high\-impact Solution Consulting team, where you’ll partner with our APAC Sales and Partner teams to showcase the power of our industry\-leading tax technology. You’ll lead engaging product demonstrations and navigate technical conversations, both within Avalara’s suite and seamlessly integrated with top ERP and e\-commerce platforms.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor, you will help customers tackle complex indirect tax challenges spanning VAT, GST, and Sales \& Use Tax by leveraging Avalara’s cutting\-edge solutions. This is more than a job; it’s a unique opportunity to build global tax expertise and shape transformative customer experiences.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with our teams in Australia and India, playing a vital role in driving growth and success across the region while being part of a collaborative, high\-performance culture at the forefront of tax automation innovation.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
 Partner with our APAC Sales and Partner teams to drive presales excellence across Avalara’s tax technology suite. You’ll lead product and ERP demonstrations, scope tailored solutions, and guide technical discussions that directly address the needs of prospects and customers. Your role will be pivotal in translating complex tax requirements into simple, effective solutions.
   

  

 Engage directly with clients to uncover their unique tax challenges and design strategies that deliver real impact. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and delivery, helping customers achieve success from day one. You’ll also bring valuable market insight and thought leadership to shape Avalara’s APAC strategy and product innovation.
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* 5\+ years in presales consulting, solution consulting, or SaaS/professional services (ideally in Tax Technology).
* Strong understanding of indirect tax including VAT, GST, Sales \& Use Tax, and cross\-border compliance.
* Familiarity with ERP systems is highly preferred (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday NetSuite, Microsoft D365\)
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics and influence stakeholders.
* Highly self\-driven, adaptable, and comfortable working remotely across time zones.
* Quick learner with a passion for tax technology and delivering customer value.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

0bdc3e6b.description:
**About ElevenLabs**
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
   

  

 We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.
   

  

**We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms**
* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

* High\-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


 What we offer
   

  

* Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* Learning \& development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* Co\-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.


**About The Role**
 As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.
   

  

**As a Solutions Engineer, You Can Expect To**
* Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process.
* Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions.
* Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition.
* Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency.
* Build self\-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently.
* Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real!


**Requirements**
 We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you:
   

  

* Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.
* Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support
* Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled.
* Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams.
* Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions
* Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity
* Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.


**Location**
 This role is remote, but candidates must be in India
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

AI Solutions Engineer \- Mergers\& Acquisitions
  
  

At Roche Digital Technology (RDT), innovation meets purpose. As a global community of business\-minded technologists, we are shaping the future of digital healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting\-edge technologies—harnessing artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by passion, we build digital solutions that enable smarter ways of working, unlock human potential, and drive meaningful breakthroughs for patients worldwide.
  
  

Work Environment\& Schedule
  
  

We balance flexibility with in\-person connection, averaging two days per week in the office for workshops, town halls, team meetings, and collaborative events.
  
Because we operate across global time zones, this role requires frequent availability during late afternoons and evenings (after 5:00 PM–6:00 PM).
  
  

**About Our Team:** Partnering Digital Solutions
  
  

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI\-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation \- building scalable data infrastructure, enabling intelligent workflows, and integrating advanced AI capabilities to accelerate decision\-making and unlock business value.
  
  

Our work spans multiple high\-impact initiatives, including AI\-enabled partnering solutions, intelligent data products, workflow automation, and enterprise\-scale data and AI integrations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI\-enabled partnering at Roche by operationalizing innovative capabilities that directly support strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling and operationalizing AI and intelligence capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, Data Scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to implement scalable AI\-enabled workflows, integrations, automation solutions, and intelligent applications that support partnering operations and decision making.
  
  

This role combines AI enablement, integration engineering, workflow orchestration, cloud\-native solution development, and operationalization of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. In addition, the role offers opportunities to contribute to modern web application development and user\-facing AI experiences where needed.
  
  

**You will be responsible for:**  

AI Workflow\& Solution Enablement
  
  

* Support the implementation and operationalization of AI\-enabled solutions across partnering platforms and intelligence products.
* Develop and integrate AI workflows that support automation, decision support, insights generation, and orchestration of AI\-enabled capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.


System Integration\& API Development
  
  

* Develop and maintain APIs and integration services that connect AI capabilities, enterprise platforms, and data ecosystems.
* Enable seamless integration between internal platforms, external data sources, AI services, and workflow orchestration frameworks.


**AI\& Agent Integration:**  

* Support the integration of AI services, LLM\-based applications, and agentic workflows into enterprise solutions and partnering processes.
* Collaborate with AI and data teams to operationalize intelligent capabilities and scalable automation workflows.


Cloud\-Native Solution Development
  
  

* Build and deploy scalable services and integrations using cloud\-native technologies and AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, and API\-based architectures.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and Roche security standards


Data\& Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of structured and unstructured data sources across partnering platforms, analytics solutions, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Enable reliable data exchange and orchestration across internal and external systems. Frontend\& User Experience Development (Bonus Capability)
* Contribute to the development of modern web applications and user\-facing AI experiences using technologies such as React or similar frontend frameworks. Support creation of dashboards, AI assistants, intelligent workflows, and self\-service analytics interfaces that improve usability and adoption.


Automation\& Operational Efficiency
  
  

* Develop automation capabilities that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency across partnering activities.
* Support monitoring, logging, and operational reliability of AI\-enabled workflows and integrations.


MLOps\& AI Operationalization
  
  

* Enable operationalization and lifecycle management of AI\-enabled capabilities by contributing to deployment workflows, monitoring, orchestration, observability, and operational reliability of AI and LLM\-based solutions.
* Collaborate with AI, data, and architecture teams to support scalable AI services, model integrations, prompt management, workflow orchestration, and operational governance aligned with enterprise AI standards.


Collaboration\& Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Work in a cross\-functional Agile environment and collaborate closely with product owners, data and AI teams, architects, vendors, and business stakeholders to
* continuously improve platforms, workflows, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Contribute to evolving engineering practices, AI enablement standards, and operational best practices across PDS.


Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, integration engineering, platform engineering, or AI solution development.
* Strong experience developing APIs and backend services using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or Java.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems, cloud services, APIs, and data platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native technologies, preferably AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, or API Gateway.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps concepts including deployment, monitoring, orchestration, observability, and operational support of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Familiarity with AI operational frameworks, model lifecycle management, or cloud\-native AI deployment patterns.
* Exposure to AI gateways, prompt management, vector databases, or orchestration frameworks is a plus.
* Strong understanding of system integration, scalability, reliability, and operational support.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data across multiple systems.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience operationalizing AI or ML\-enabled workflows and applications.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, or AI integration patterns.
* Experience integrating AI\-enabled capabilities into enterprise applications or workflows. Experience or exposure to modern frontend development using React or similar web frameworks.
* Experience developing dashboards, intelligent user interfaces, or self\-service analytics applications.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration, automation frameworks, or event\-driven architectures. Understanding of enterprise authentication, authorization, and SSO integration.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or partnering/business development domains is a plus. Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.


Why Join Us?
  
  

* Help operationalize AI and intelligence capabilities that directly support Roche’s strategic partnering decisions.
* Work on innovative AI\-enabled solutions, automation workflows, and intelligent integrations at enterprise scale.
* Collaborate with product leaders, AI specialists, architects, and external innovation partners. Contribute to the evolution of modern data and AI capabilities across Roche’s partnering ecosystem.
* Work in an agile, mission\-driven environment focused on innovation, collaboration, and meaningful business impact.


**What you get:**  

* Salary range 14,000 \- 26,000 PLN grossbased on the employment contract.
* Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).
* Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).
* Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
* Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
* Vacation subsidy available.
* Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).
* Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).
* Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.
* Stock share purchase additions.
* Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!


Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.
  
\#RDT2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Job Description
**Position: Microsoft 365 L2 Administrator**  

**Location:** Belapur, Navi Mumbai


**Experience:** 5–6 years
  

**Role Level:** L2
  

**Technology:** Microsoft 365 / Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) / Exchange Online / On\-Premises Exchange / Intune


**Job Summary**


We are looking for an experienced **Microsoft 365 L2 Administrator** responsible for providing advanced operational and technical support for Microsoft 365 services. The role will involve troubleshooting complex incidents, user administration, mailbox management, Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD activities, Exchange Online and basic on\-premises Exchange administration.


**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Microsoft 365 Administration**


* Provide L2 support for Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.

* Manage Microsoft 365 users, licenses, groups and service requests.
* Analyse recurring incidents and identify permanent solutions.
* Handle escalated incidents from L1/service desk teams.
* Maintain incident, problem and change management processes as per defined SLA.

**2\. Exchange Online**


* Troubleshoot mailbox access, mail flow, delivery and authentication issues.
* Perform mailbox\-related administrative activities such as permissions, shared mailboxes, distribution groups and forwarding.
* Troubleshoot Outlook connectivity and Microsoft 365 authentication issues.
* Basic understanding of Exchange Online message trace and mail\-flow troubleshooting.
* Understanding of Exchange Online policies and mailbox configurations.

**3\. Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD – Basic Knowledge**


* Basic administration and troubleshooting knowledge of **Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)**.
* User and group management, including basic understanding of security groups and Microsoft 365 groups.
* Basic knowledge of authentication, SSO and MFA.
* Understanding of user sign\-in and authentication\-related issues.
* Basic knowledge of Conditional Access policies and troubleshooting access issues.
* Basic understanding of Entra ID Connect / directory synchronization.
* Ability to review basic sign\-in and audit logs for troubleshooting.
* Understanding of the relationship between on\-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.

**4\. On\-Premises Exchange Server – Basic Knowledge**


* Basic administration and troubleshooting of on\-premises Microsoft Exchange Server.
* Understanding of Exchange mailbox databases, connectors and mail flow.
* Basic knowledge of Receive/Send Connectors and SMTP flow.
* Troubleshoot basic mailbox, Outlook and mail\-delivery issues.
* Basic understanding of Exchange hybrid environment and synchronization between on\-premises Exchange and Exchange Online.
* Coordinate with L3/Exchange specialists for complex issues.

**5\. Microsoft Intune – Basic to Intermediate Knowledge**


* Basic administration of Microsoft Intune.
* Understanding of device enrollment and compliance.
* Basic troubleshooting of Windows and mobile device enrollment issues.
* Knowledge of configuration profiles, compliance policies and application deployment.
* Understanding of device management through Microsoft Intune.

**6\. Incident \& Problem Management**


* Handle L2 incidents within defined SLA and operational procedures.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Escalate complex issues to L3/engineering teams with proper troubleshooting details.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation and knowledge articles.
* Participate in major incident and service restoration activities.

**Required Technical Skills**


* Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting.
* Exchange Online administration.
* Basic Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD administration.
* Basic on\-premises Exchange Server knowledge.
* Basic Active Directory concepts.
* Microsoft Intune fundamentals.
* Windows 10/11 troubleshooting.
* Outlook troubleshooting.
* PowerShell fundamentals for Microsoft 365 administration.
* Knowledge of MFA, SSO and authentication concepts.
* Good understanding of DNS, SMTP and basic networking concepts.

**Preferred Certifications**


* Microsoft Certified: **Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert**
* Microsoft Certified: **Identity and Access Administrator Associate**
* MS\-900: Microsoft 365 Fundamentals
* MD\-102: Endpoint Administrator
* Exchange\-related Microsoft certification or equivalent experience.

**Key Competencies**


* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently handle L2 technical issues.
* Good communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work in a 24×7 support environment, including rotational shifts.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work under SLA and handle high\-priority/P1 incidents.
* Good coordination with L1, L3, OEM and Microsoft support teams.

**Education**


Bachelor's degree Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Experience**


**5–6 years of relevant experience in Microsoft 365 administration and enterprise IT support**, with hands\-on experience in Exchange Online and working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD and on\-premises Exchange.

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Engineer with strong hands\-on expertise in Azure, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift, combined with solid application development and DevOps skills. The role involves designing and managing scalable cloud platforms, implementing Infrastructure as Code, optimizing performance, and building advanced simulators and test environments to support enterprise\-grade applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Management**
* Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including:
+ Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, and connectivity
+ Compute resources (VMs, AKS, scale sets)
+ Storage solutions (Blob, Disk, Files)
+ Security services (Key Vault, Azure AD integration, policies)

* Architect, implement, and maintain Red Hat OpenShift container platforms for enterprise application deployment.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning.
* Manage Kubernetes clusters (Azure Kubernetes Service / OpenShift) and orchestrate containerized applications across multiple environments.


**Performance \& Optimization**
* Plan and conduct comprehensive performance testing using tools like JMeter and Neoload.
* Analyze application and infrastructure performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and resource constraints.
* Implement performance tuning strategies for cloud resources, container platforms, and applications.
* Define and maintain performance benchmarks, SLAs, and SLOs for critical systems and services.


**Networking \& Security**
* Design and implement Azure networking solutions including:
+ VNets, subnets, peering, and VPN/ExpressRoute
+ Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewalls, and routing
+ Application Gateways, Load Balancers, and ingress solutions

* Configure and manage OpenShift networking components such as SDN, ingress controllers, and network policies.
* Implement and enforce security best practices for cloud and container environments, including identity, access management, and compliance controls.
* Troubleshoot complex networking issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, collaborating with infrastructure and security teams.


**Application Development \& DevOps**
* Develop and maintain cloud\-native applications using modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, C\#, or similar).
* Design and develop simulators for testing, training, and validation purposes, supporting various system and integration scenarios.
* Build mock services and virtual environments to simulate real\-world systems, third\-party integrations, and external APIs.
* Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment using GitHub Actions (and other DevOps tools as needed).
* Collaborate with development teams to optimize application architecture for cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
* Create automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) for infrastructure management and deployment workflows.
* Build realistic simulators to replicate production environments, external dependencies, and failure scenarios.
* Develop test harnesses and simulation frameworks to support load testing, resilience testing, and chaos engineering.
* Build training and sandbox environments for development, QA, and experimentation.
* Design data\-driven simulators with configurable scenarios and behaviors to support complex business and operational use cases.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (networking, compute, storage, security).
* Experience architecting and administering Red Hat OpenShift or other enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Practical experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (or similar tools).
* Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes, containers (Docker), and microservices.
* Proven experience in performance testing using JMeter, Neoload, or equivalent tools.
* Strong grasp of cloud networking concepts, security controls, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
* Experience developing cloud\-native applications using at least one modern programming language.
* Hands\-on experience building CI/CD pipelines (preferably with GitHub Actions) and integrating with cloud platforms.
* Experience creating simulators, mock services, and complex test environments for application and integration testing.
* Good understanding of DevOps practices, automation, and observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing).


**Soft Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical issues across infrastructure, networking, and applications.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams (development, QA, operations, security, and business stakeholders).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proactive attitude, willingness to learn new technologies, and ownership mindset for assigned tasks and deliverables.
* High attention to detail and strong commitment to quality, reliability, and operational excellence.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Relevant certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or DevOps will be an added advantage.

894db88d.title: Sr.Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business, Private Brands, Recommerce
894db88d.description:
**Description**
 Our organization spans three distinct Amazon India businesses — Amazon Business (comprising Self\-Service Registered / SSR and CPS enterprise sales), Private Brands, and ReCommerce — each on a multi\-million\-dollar, WW\-leading growth trajectory. Delivering that growth depends on executing large, complex, cross\-organizational programs across CX, SX, sales, tech, pricing, supply chain, and operations, often with dependencies on Worldwide and partner teams. Increasingly, the most valuable of these programs are AI\-powered — agentic buying assistants, AI\-driven pricing and selection, intelligent automation across returns and recovery — so AI fluency is central to the role, even as the mandate spans the full breadth of the org's most critical programs.
   

  

 We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the most critical and complex programs across the portfolio, with a primary focus on Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) and targeted support for the largest, highest\-complexity programs in Private Brands and ReCommerce. This is a senior, cross\-cutting role spanning three separate businesses: you will drive alignment across engineering, product, and business leaders.Many of these programs are customer\-facing AI products; others are platform, pricing, expansion, supply\-chain, or compliance programs — you will own the hardest ones regardless of type.
   

  

 You will inherit a portfolio of the org's marquee initiatives. Success looks like complex programs delivered on time across team boundaries, dependencies sequenced before they become blockers, and leadership given a single, trusted view of program health.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Own the largest and most complex programs in Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) — the primary focus of the role — driving them end\-to\-end from definition through launch across engineering, product, pricing, GTMO/sales, and operations. These span customer\-facing AI products as well as platform, pricing, expansion, and compliance programs.
   

  

 Lead delivery of customer\-facing AI experiences where they are on the critical path — turning fast\-moving AI capabilities into shipped products with clear customer value — while applying the same rigor to the org's other complex, high\-stakes programs.
   

  

 Provide targeted program leadership to Private Brands and ReCommerce — two separate businesses — for their largest and most complex initiatives only, prioritizing where cross\-org complexity and business impact are highest.
   

  

 Drive cross\-business and cross\-org dependency management — identify, sequence, and unblock the dependencies (tech, data, model/evaluation readiness, tax/accounting, supply chain, WW partner teams) that cause complex programs to slip.
   

  

 Establish and run program governance — mechanisms, status reporting, and leadership reviews that give each business a single view of health, risk, and critical path.
   

  

 Be an AI\-forward operator. Use GenAI and internal AI tooling extensively to accelerate planning, synthesize status, model dependencies, and compress work that traditionally took days into hours — and help raise the bar on how the broader team adopts AI in program management.
   

  

 Partner with SDMs and business leaders across all three businesses to convert strategy (OP1/OP2, 3YF/LRF) into sequenced, resourced, executable plans, and mentor other PMs/TPMs on execution rigor.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You start with AI as your co\-pilot — synthesizing overnight status across your programs and flagging the two dependencies now on the critical path. Mid\-morning, you run a program review with an SSR and a CPS engineering team building a customer\-facing agentic assistant, locking sequencing on the evaluation and guardrail work that gates launch. Switching context to a separate business, you align a Private Brands pricing\-program lead and a WW partner team on a stalled funding\-and\-timeline decision — a program that has nothing to do with AI but everything to do with cross\-org complexity. In the afternoon you prep the portfolio health view for your leadership review, escalating one complex ReCommerce program at risk with options and a recommendation. You close by shaping the plan for a newly greenlit, high\-complexity Amazon Business initiative — defining scope, dependencies, and critical path before it kicks off.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

2000f6de.title: Pre Sales Senior Solutions Engineer
2000f6de.description:
**About this role** 





 You'll be the technical voice in the room on our most important deals. Sitting across from CFOs, finance leaders, and engineering teams, you'll understand how a prospect's business actually works, then show them how Zenskar solves a problem most vendors can't crack. 
 





 You'll be the product expert on sales calls and run discovery, build demos on real customer scenarios, design the integration, and own the technical win alongside the AE.
 





 This is a hands\-on role. You'll write SQL, poke at REST APIs, map data flows, and configure Zenskar to prove it works before the deal closes. If your instinct is to open the product and build the thing rather than talk around it, you'll fit here.
 




  





**What you will be doing** 




**Solutioning** 



* Understand customer billing models and configure Zenskar contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured Zenskar workflows and setups.
* Design solutions for complex B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features.



**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Discovery** 



* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders. Understand their billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features.
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses. Build demos tied to the prospect's real scenario, not a generic tour: set up metered plans, show usage ingestion and rated invoices, and point to where revenue is recognized.
* Design the integration. Map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into Zenskar, and flag idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems.
* Own the technical win. Qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale.



**Business Case \& Enablement** 



* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs. Tie capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed, not a feature list.
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clear handoff references when transitioning deals.
* Communicate clearly, simple enough for a CXO, precise enough for technical teams.



**Internal Coordination** 



* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering.
* Raise and follow through on time\-sensitive issues so momentum is never lost.



  





**Key qualifications** 



* 5\+ years total experience, with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role: solutions or sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend and integrations work. Actual building, not support tickets.
* You can write real SQL comfortably (group by, window functions, date logic) and have built or debugged REST API integrations. You understand the difference between an API and a webhook without having to think about it.
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS product experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent.
* You've been client\-facing in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls with real customers.
* Comfortable supporting enterprise\-grade deal cycles and multi\-stakeholder buying processes, with US or international customers.
* You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and with an engineer on the same day.
* CS or engineering degree, or demonstrable equivalent shipped work.
* Experience at a small company (under 100 people, seed to Series A) is a plus, not a must.
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours, roughly 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST to cover US afternoons, on weekdays.
* A sense of humor and the ability to not take yourself too seriously. We're building something hard, and that's more fun with people who can laugh at the chaos.



**Location** 



* Hybrid, 2 days per week (Tuesday, Thursday)
* Office Location: Indiranagar, Bengaluru
* Address: 3rd Floor, A wing No 1, Carlton Towers, HAL Old Airport Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008

37b69ac3.title: Solution Architect (Presales & Implementation) | Fynd TMS
37b69ac3.description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.
   

  

 Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.
   

  

**The role in one line**
 You own a Fynd TMS customer end to end \- from the first solution discussion in the sales cycle, through design and go\-live, and then as the person accountable for that account running well and growing.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Fynd TMS sells into enterprise retail, distribution and 3PL operations where no two logistics networks look alike. Deals are won on whether we can credibly map a customer's dispatch reality \- hubs, zones, rate cards, fleet mix, SLAs, COD, returns \- onto the product, and then actually deliver it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Presales and solutioning
* Join sales conversations as the product and logistics authority: run discovery on the customer's current dispatch flow, systems landscape and pain points.
* Build and deliver tailored demos and pilots \- not the generic deck, but the customer's own network configured in the product.
* Own the solution narrative in RFPs, RFIs and proposals; write the solution and scope sections of the SOW.
* Do gap analysis between customer requirements and current product capability. Decide what is configuration, what is customization, and what is a genuine "no" \- and say so early.
* Size effort and feasibility with engineering before commitments are made, so we don't sell what we can't ship.
* Requirements to engineering
* Convert custom client requirements into clear, unambiguous requirement documents (functional flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases, data contracts).
* Drive those requirements with engineering and product through prioritization, build and deployment \- chasing status, unblocking decisions, and keeping the customer's commercial timeline visible internally.
* Act as the translation layer in both directions: business intent into engineering specs, and technical constraints into language the client's ops head accepts.
* Onboarding and go\-live
* Run implementation as a project: plan, milestones, RACI, weekly governance with the client.
* Configure and validate masters \- hubs, zones, service areas, rate cards, SLA/TAT rules, vehicle and rider profiles, route optimization parameters.
* Coordinate integrations with the client's OMS/ERP/WMS and any carrier or 3PL partners; test APIs and webhooks yourself before handing them to the client.
* Drive data migration, UAT, pilot rollout at a single hub or store cluster, and on\-ground training for supervisors, dispatchers and riders.
* Run hypercare through go\-live and stabilization; sit in the control room on day one if that's what it takes.
* Post\-live account ownership
* Own adoption and health: are trips actually being planned in the system, is the rider app being used, is EPOD capture clean, are dashboards being looked at.
* Run monthly and quarterly reviews with the client, tied to their metrics \- cost per delivery, vehicle utilization, on\-time performance, planning time saved.
* Be the escalation path for issues; coordinate resolution with support and engineering and close the loop with the client.
* Spot and drive expansion: new hubs, new geographies, additional modules, additional business units. Own renewal readiness.
* Feed structured, prioritized product feedback back into the roadmap.


**What We're Looking For**
**Must have**
* 4–8 years in presales, solution consulting, implementation, or customer success \- in logistics technology, supply chain SaaS, or enterprise B2B SaaS sold to operations teams.
* Working knowledge of at least one of: transportation management, last\-mile/mid\-mile delivery, dispatch planning, route optimization, fleet operations, or 3PL/carrier operations.
* Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise implementation from kickoff to go\-live \- you can walk us through one in detail, including what went wrong.
* Technical fluency without being an engineer: comfortable with APIs and Postman, reading JSON, basic SQL, Excel modelling. You can debug a bad integration payload well enough to know whose problem it is.
* Strong verbal and written communication. Requirement docs, review decks and client emails are a large part of this job.
* Willing to be on the ground \- warehouses, hubs, and client offices, not only on calls.


**Good to have**
* Experience with TMS, WMS, OMS or route\-optimization products (Shipsy, LogiNext, FarEye, Locus, Bringg, Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM, or in\-house platforms at Delhivery, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, Porter, Zypp and similar).
* Exposure to retail, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or enterprise logistics buyers.
* Comfort with route\-optimization concepts \- constraints, capacity, time windows, solver behaviour.


**Who This Is NOT For**
* Someone who wants a pure sales quota role with no delivery accountability.
* Someone who wants a pure project management role with no client\-facing commercial exposure.
* Someone who needs a fully documented product and a settled process to work inside.


**What do we offer?**
**Growth**
 At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we're seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers. Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we'll reimburse the costs to support your development.
   

  

**Culture**
 We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections. \- Regular community engagement and team\-building activities \- Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture
   

  

**Wellness**
 Your well\-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.
   

  

 Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

**Job Title:** 
 Sr. Technical Architect, PS
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Reports to** 
 : Director, Professional Services
   

  

**A quick snapshot…**
 Conga is seeking an experienced Technical Architect with over 12\+ years of work experience who will play a key role in implementing Quote\-to\-Cash suite of products, including CPQ (configure/price/quote), contract management, revenue management and other related solutions. Perform hands\-on design, solution architectures, architecture roadmaps, prototyping, proof\-of\-concepts, development tasks and integrating Conga products as required in support of current and new projects. Ensuring the solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements. Working with global teams actively for implementation. Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Leading technical teams to deliver flexible and scalable solutions.
   

  

**Why it’s a big deal…**
 A Technical Architect will help us design and deliver solutions for enterprise\-grade customers using Conga products. The intention is to recommend the best solution for a given set of requirements and articulate the trade\-offs involved in choosing one solution over another. Leading design sessions and writing design documents by managing the delivery of integrations and custom extensions will be most critical. This person should also be highly proficient and successful in managing the technical and overall scope of the client’s expectations.
   

  

**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.** 
 You should understand business requirements regarding product management and develop solution design and enhancements using different configurations, using Salesforce or Dot Net platform (APEX, Visual Force, C\#, Angular / React JS or equivalent front\-end technologies). Thorough unit testing with a high level of code coverage is necessary. You should have demonstrated experience of working as part of an Agile development team. Experience automated deployment process will help score more.
   

  

**Implementation and Integrations.** 
 The ability to drive deep\-level technical discussions with prospects and help set expectations for potential project efforts is a must. A Technical Architect would interact directly with clients and end\-users on a regular basis to analyze project objectives and capability requirements, including specifications for user interfaces, customized applications, and interactions with internal / external applications.
   

  

**Design and Pre\-Sales Activities.** 
 You would be responsible for providing hands\-on expert level assistance to developers for any issues. Designing and managing the execution deployment and testing ensuring a quality solution is delivered will be the key. Ability to lead a requirement gathering session, write requirements, architecture documents and manage integrations. This role will include participation in pre\-sales activities as and when required.
   

  

**Education** 
 . A bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent.
   

  

**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Champion of the Customer** 
 . You understand that customers are one of business’ most important assets and you take that seriously. With more than 11,000 customers around the globe entrusting Conga with their business we make a commitment to their success and would love to hear how you will too!
   

  

**Analytical thinker and creative problem solver.** 
 You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter \- a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs.
   

  

**Quality oriented** 
 . You rarely make mistakes because you have good processes in place to ensure that every detail is correct. But in those rare occasions when errors are realized (let’s face it, it happens to the best of us from time to time), you own them, correct them, learn from them, and then quickly adjust and communicate processes to ensure the same mistake doesn’t happen twice. It’s your transparency, authenticity and humility are what sets you apart from the rest
   

  

**Tools and certifications.** 
 Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Working experience with Atlassian Suite. Salesforce Platform Developer certifications (level I and II are preferred) or Microsoft Solutions Developer (MCSD) / Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE)
   

  

**Industry expertise.** 
 Let’s face it, understanding of the software as a service industry would allow you to hit the ground running.
   

  

**Did we pique your interest?**
 If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!
   

  

**Preferred Resume Format**
 We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.
   

  

**Don’t meet every requirement for the role?** 


 Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
